 KTC'yi şöyle anlatıyor: 


 Kurucuları arasında Hikmet Bil (Hürriyet gazetesinde gazeteci), Dr. Hüsamettin Canöztürk (TMTF Başkanı), Orhan Birgit (Yeni Sabah’ta gazeteci, avukat), Ziya Somer (öğrenci), Ahmet Emin Yalman (gazeteci), Hasan Nevzat Karagil (Kıbrıs Türk Kültür Derneği) ve Kamil Önal (gazeteci) bulunuyordu. Başbakan Menderes ve Dışişleri Bakanı Fuat Köprülü tarafından kabul edilen dernek yöneticilerine kamuoyunu Kıbrıs davasını destekleme için hazırlama görevi verilmişti. Bu dernek kısa zamanda devlet desteği ile İstanbul’un birçok semtinde ve bazı Anadolu kentlerinde şubeler açmıştı. Hâkim Amiral Fahri Çoker dosyasındaki belgelere göre, ‘Kıbrıs Türktür Cemiyeti’ne hükümet tarafından kuruluş sırasında 35,000 TL ve daha sonra da 200,000 TL ödeme yapılmıştı.


Cemiyet bir yandan yarı-resmi öğrenci örgütlerinden destekçi bulurken, diğer yandan da ‘milliyetçi’ çizgideki sendikalarla da işbirliği içindeydi. Örneğin KTC’nin Paşabahçe şubesi, Paşabahçe Şişe-Cam İşçileri Sendikası tarafından kurulmuştu. Çok kısa zamanda İstanbul’da onüç şube açan KTC aynı zamanda DP ilçe örgütleri tarafından da destekleniyordu. author: Jake Johnson
title: German Far Right Party AfD Wins Regional Election, Thanks Musk for Support
content:
Alternative for Germany won the most votes in the Saxony-Anhalt election but fell short of an absolute majority.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

The far-right Alternative for Germany party thanked the world’s richest man, Elon Musk, after decisively winning a key regional election on Sunday, sparking alarm across Europe and around the globe.

Ulrich Siegmund, AfD’s lead candidate in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt, praised Musk — who has openly advocated for the far-right, xenophobic party — for his support and “clear and highly important perspective on the political developments of our time — including here in Germany.” Siegmund wrote that if AfD ends up leading the state government, the party “would very much welcome the opportunity for strong and constructive cooperation,” adding that “Germany would once again be a place worth investing in.”

Siegmund’s post on the social media platform X, which Musk owns, came after AfD won just over 44% of the vote in the Saxony-Anhalt election, trouncing the Christian Democratic Union (CDU), led by Chancellor Friedrich Merz. CDU finished a distant second with 17.1% of the vote.

“Well done!” Musk wrote, in German, following AfD’s election win. The mega-billionaire has called AfD “the only hope for Germany.”

US President Donald Trump, a political ally of Musk, posted to Truth Social a screenshot of exit polls showing AfD leading the regional election on Sunday afternoon.

“Leave it to Trump to celebrate the victory of a far-right German party that shows sympathy for the Nazis, downplays the Holocaust, and flirts with Putin,” Kenneth Roth, the former executive director of Human Rights Watch, wrote on social media in response to the US president.

The Associated Press noted that “to win an absolute majority, AfD needed to clinch 42 of the 83 seats in the state parliament, but the party appeared on track to win 39. Depending on the ultimate make-up of parliament, it could still end up leading the state government.” Siegmund would be the first far-right leader to govern a German state since 1945.

But other German parties have refused to work with AfD, raising doubts about its ability to form a government in Saxony-Anhalt, which has a population of around 2.1 million people.

David Adler, co-general coordinator of the Progressive International, wrote that the election “sent a clear message, to Germany as to all of Europe, that the far-right rampage is not slowing down, but accelerating instead.”

AfD focuses heavily on immigration, vowing “deportation from minute one” and calling for abolition of “the fundamental right to asylum.”

“In addition to deporting immigrants, the party has proposed cutting funding for public broadcasters, banning gay pride flags in schools, and teaching more Russian, as well as tax breaks for large families and free childcare,” The New York Times reported. The newspaper noted that Siegmund declined to condemn supporters who “chanted his surname… in the style of the Nazi salute, ‘Sieg Heil.’”

European officials voiced deep concern about AfD’s surge in the regional election, with France’s Europe minister calling the results “a serious moment.”

“Nationalism and xenophobia will never be a solution,” said Benjamin Haddad. “We must listen with humility to the anger, the concerns, the fears, and respond to them. We cannot forget our history. That is the meaning behind the choices made by France and Germany.”

Spanish Julen Bollain wrote on social media that “the far-right is managing to turn discontent, economic insecurity, and disaffection into votes.”

“AfD is doing something that should especially worry the left: transforming precarity, frustration, and disaffection into political identity and votes,” Bollain added. “And if we don’t manage to give a collective response to the existing social discontent, someone always shows up ready to turn it into fear, hate, and scapegoats. And there they beat us, because they move like fish in water.”

As Trump cracks down on political speech, independent media is increasingly necessary.

author: Sonja Eismann
title: Kleidung als Werkzeug für Neonazis
content:
Modeprofessorin Elke Gaugele zeigt in ihrem neuen Buch „Fashion und Faschismus“, wie Neonazis und die Neue Rechte Mode gezielt für ihre Zwecke instrumentalisieren.

Als Modetheoretikerin untersuchst du rechte Kleidungscodes. Als im Sommer eine Pressemeldung zu dem Forschungsprojekt des österreichischen Forschungsfonds, aus dem auch dieses Buch entstanden ist, online ging, gab es von rechten Parteien und Boulevardmedien sofort scharfe Angriffe. Ein Kultursprecher der FPÖ sprach von einer „linken Modepolizei“, einer dekadenten „Polohemd-Studie“ und „linksradikaler Pseudowissenschaft“. Sind diese Diffamierungen Teil der „Fashion Violence“, die du in deinem Buch skizzierst? Ja, Fashion Violence beschreibt, dass Mode zum einen Mikroaggressionen aussenden kann und diese gleichzeitig verleugnet und bagatellisiert werden. Dass also gesagt wird: „Das ist doch nur ein Kleidungsstück, ein harmloses Poloshirt, was regt ihr euch so auf? Eine staatlich finanzierte Wissenschaftlerin forscht zu banaler Alltagskleidung, fass dir mal an den Kopf!“ All das ist Teil dieses Gaslightings, das auch mit der Mode selbst einhergeht. Da wir dezidiert rechtsextreme Modeproduzent*innen untersuchen, die Labels mit entsprechenden Codes und Hassbotschaften herstellen, ist es auch eine Diffamierungskampagne gegen Rechtsextremismusforschung. Inwiefern kann rechte Mode – im Buch auch „Fascion“, als Verbindung von ­Fashion und Fascism – überhaupt Gewalt ausüben? Mode ist an sich schon historisch mit Gewalt und Ideologie verbunden, indem sie immer wieder Klassen und Geschlechter herstellt, Race formiert, In- und Outgroups voneinander abgrenzt etc. Schon 1973 erklärte der Vordenker der Neuen Rechten, Armin Mohler, in seinem Essay „Der faschistische Stil“ diesen zum ästhetischen Leitbild. Extrem rechte Mode basiert heute auf der Sprache von Jugend- und Subkulturen. Sie stellt Gesellschaft als ständige Kampfzone dar, für die man sich aus- und aufrüsten muss. Das funktioniert auf der einen Ebene durch „Street Battles“, für die die Grundgarderobe aus den eigentlich Schwarz und migrantisch geprägten Street Styles angeeignet wurde. Die andere Ebene rechten Powerdressings ist die des Klassenkampfs von oben, z. B. ein Maximilian Krah, der sich als Dandy mit Einstecktuch inszeniert. &…Teile diesen Artikel

author: CNT Valladolid
title: Nativa o extranjera, la misma clase obrera: paremos los pies al fascismo
content:
Dentro de las convocatorias antifascistas que se multiplicaron por todo el Estado el día 2 de septiembre -en respuesta a las esperpénticas convocatorias «Por Ceuta» animadas por el espíritu de la flotilla de Marcos de Quinto-, las compañeras antifascistas de Valladolid nos manifestamos contra el racismo que, esta vez con la excusa de Ceuta, empapa nuestra sociedad, impulsado por las élites burguesas con el propósito de dividirnos y debilitarnos.


Al grito de ¡Ninguna frontera contra la clase obrera¡ una buena parte de quienes luchamos todos los días contra el racismo y el fascismo en calles y curros nos concentramos ayer en Valladolid dentro de la oleada de movilizaciones por Ceuta y para parar de raíz la ofensiva fascista.


Reproducimos aquí una octavilla que convocaba a la manifestación:


El próximo miércoles se han convocado concentraciones en “apoyo a Ceuta” en diversas ciudades del Estado español. Esa es la excusa tras la que se esconde el mensaje, propaganda racista que no busca otra cosa que promover el odio al migrante.


Valladolid no es diferente, y la propaganda corre de la mano de la reacción: grupos como Falange o Patriam TV, asociaciones de empresarios o el propio alcalde. Beneficiarios, gestores y defensores de los intereses de los capitalistas.


En este contexto, no debemos olvidar quién es el verdadero enemigo: los que empobrecen y asesinan, no los migrantes obligados a huir.


Los que defienden y se aprovechan de un sistema basado en la explotación, la desigualdad y el colonialismo, no quienes sufren sus consecuencias y su miseria.


Contra su racismo, contra el capitalismo, respondamos con unidad de clase. ¡Paremos los pies al racismo!


Los medios de comunicación recogieron declaraciones de nuestra compañera Bea:


Estamos aquí ante la desastrosa reacción violenta que hemos venido sufriendo y viendo a través de los medios en la ciudad de Ceuta. Algunas voces califican este hecho de «invasión» sin dar importancia a la tragedia humana que está suponiendo.


Cerramos esta crónica dando voz a

Lara Salcedo

, una de las participantes en la red de grupos  que está ejerciendo el apoyo mutuo como respuesta a esta tragedia –

No Name Kitchen

,

Border Resistance

,

Apoyo Mutuo Ceuta

-. Apoyo mutuo que. a pesar del sabotaje que está sufriendo por parte de los cuerpos y fuerzas de «seguridad» del Estado, o precisamente por ello, se confirma como la herramienta insustituible que necesita la clase trabajadora en estas situaciones.


«La situación de los migrantes aquí es terrible. La mayoría está en situación de calle hace un mes. Los primeros días no tuvieron acceso a comida ni agua. Respecto al acceso al sistema de protección internacional, hay una imposibilidad material de acceder, no solo para los adultos sino para los menores. Lo único que sí ha funcionado para proteger a los menores fue la organización popular de los barrios».


Última hora –

https://www.instagram.com/apoyomutuoceuta/


El pasado 4 de septiembre de 2026, un menor en territorio ceutí ha sido deportado por ayudar a otra persona que intentaba entrar a nado desde Marruecos a Ceuta. El menor deportado se encontraba en las inmediaciones junto a otros compañeros, quienes también intentaron ayudar al chico que estaba a punto de ahogarse. Al ser quien más se involucró en el rescate, fue captado de forma ilegal, sin respetar las garantías y los derechos que corresponden a los menores, y trasladado a Marruecos contra su voluntad, como podemos apreciar en el vídeo.


Ningún ser humano es ilegal.


El pasado martes 1 de septiembre las fuerzas de represión del estado intentaron desalojar el campamento improvisado de mujeres en movimiento situado en frente del CETI en Ceuta.


Ante esta situación las mujeres se organizaron y pudieron quedarse en el lugar, con una promesa de que iban a ser acogidas.

author: Unknown
title: Almanya'da Saksonya-Anhalt eyaletindeki seçimleri aşırı sağcı AfD kazandı
content:
Fotoğraf: Christian Wiediger/Unsplash

Almanya'da, Eylül ayındaki eyalet seçimlerinin ilk durağından sonuç çıktı. Ülkenin doğusundaki Saksonya-Anhalt eyaletinde gerçekleşen meclis seçimlerinde aşırı sağcı Almanya için Alternatif (AfD), oyların yüzde 44,5'ini alarak birinci sıraya yerleşti.

Alman kamu yayıncısı ARD’nin açıkladığı verilere göre AfD, beş yıl önceki seçimlere kıyasla oy oranını 23,7 puan artırdı.

2021 seçimlerinde yüzde 20,8 oy alan AfD'nin ulaştığı bu seviye, İkinci Dünya Savaşı'nın ardından Almanya’da kurulan siyasi sistem ve demokrasi açısından en ağır tehditlerden biri olarak değerlendiriliyor.

Eyalette 2002 yılından bu yana tüm başbakanları çıkaran Hristiyan Demokrat Birlik (CDU), açık ara farkla ikinci sıraya geriledi. 35 yaşındaki aşırı sağcı aday Ulrich Siegmund liderliğinde seçime giren AfD'nin elde ettiği bu sonuç; önümüzdeki günlerde Niedersachsen, Berlin ve Mecklenburg-Vorpommern’de yapılacak eyalet seçimleri öncesinde tehlikenin tırmandığına işaret ediyor.

AfD'nin yüksek oy oranına rağmen merkez partilerin aşırı sağ ile işbirliğini reddeden 'güvenlik duvarı' siyasetini sürdürüp sürdüremeyeceği tartışılıyor.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Pas de congrès pour le RN à Orléans les 24 et 25 octobre !
content:
Texte d'appel à un contre-congrès massif et déter à Orléans (village et manifestation anti-fascistes) et à des réunions publiques partout pour des transports collectifs vers Orléans.


Et résumé de la dernière réunion publique de la plateforme anti-fasciste Ciao Fachos.


PAS DE CONGRÈS POUR LE RN !


Les 24 et 25 octobre, le RN prévoit son congrès à Orléans, avec son

meeting de lancement de campagne le 25

. Des bus partiront de partout en France pour une

démonstration de force

 du premier parti fasciste de France.


A chaque fois que le FN/RN remporte des victoires médiatiques ou politiques,

il se normalise

 comme force politique et ses idées gagnent du terrain, en témoigne la loi "permis de tuer" pour la police et gendarmerie votée cet été. Ce parti alimente surtout

la violence raciste

, comme en juin dernier, dans une discothèque à Rodez, où on a entendu : « Marine au pouvoir, les Arabes à l'abattoir. »


Face aux dangers du fascisme, notre réponse doit être

déterminée et massive

.


Les manifestations qui ont eu lieu en juillet contre le congrès de l'AfD, parti fasciste allemand, ont rassemblé

20000 manifestant.e.s

 et doivent nous donner confiance : partout dans le monde, nous sommes la majorité ! Ensemble, nous pouvons infliger une lourde défaite au RN.


Plusieurs initiatives antifascistes sont en train de s'organiser à Orléans, notamment

avec un village antifasciste le 24 et une manifestation nationale en direction du meeting le 25

. Début septembre il y aura une réunion nationale inter-organisations pour finaliser toustes ensemble l'organisation de ce week-end de mobilisation antifasciste nationale.


Nous appelons aussi toutes les organisations qui le souhaitent à

organiser des campagnes dans leurs quartiers, leurs villes et leurs villages pour appeler à manifester le 25 octobre à Orléans contre le meeting du RN

.


Au sein de la plateforme Ciao Fachos, nous travaillons sur un kit de mobilisation (argumentaire, tract, affiche...) pour les accompagner.


Rejoignez-nous !


Tractages, collages, réunions publiques, transports collectifs, soirées de récoltes de fonds :

soyons partout

, et profitons-en pour empêcher le RN de tracter sur nos marchés et coller sur nos murs.


PAS DE CAMPAGNE ET PAS DE CONGRÈS POUR LES RACISTES !


Signataires :


AcaaB (Action citoyenne antiraciste antifasciste Beaucaire), AFA Annemasse, AG anti fasciste 72, Alternatiba Orléans, Amaars (Assemblée Morbihan (Est) Antifasciste Antiraciste Rurale et Solidaire), ATTAC 45, Ciao Fachos, Collectif antifasciste Orléans, Collectif antifasciste Paris 20e, Contrevents (Côtes d'Armor), CRAAAME (Collectif Rêvolutionnaire Autonome Anarchiste Anti-fasciste du Mans et des Environs), G.E.L 72 (Groupe Étudiant Libertaire Sarthe), Gentilly Antifasciste Antiraciste, GRIF (Groupe Radical Intersectionnel Féministe) Orléans, ORA (Orléans Riposte Antifasciste), Organisation de Solidarité Trans (OST), OST Orléans, Riposte Antifasciste Marseille, Riposte Populaire, Soulèvements de la Terre Orléans, Sound of Sudan, Suresnes Antifa Antiraciste, TAF (Tours AntiFasciste)


Texte alternatif décrivant l'affiche :


Visuel avec gros message "Pas de congrès pour le RN"


On voit une foule de bras qui font des siamo tutti antifascisti


Deux pancartes "Orléans 24 - 25/10" et "mobilisations antifa"


Des drapeaux antifasciste, LGBTQIA+ et palestinien sont brandis


RÉSUMÉ DE LA RÉUNION PUBLIQUE DU 6 AOÛT DE LA PLATEFORME ANTI-FASCISTE CIAO FACHOS


Une participation massive !


70 participant·e·s, 33 organisations, dont 5 d'Orléans / du Loiret et 3 organisations nationales (VISA, ASSO Solidaires, Solidaires étudiant·e·s)


Et ça début août, une franche réussite qui annonce d'importantes victoires (et défaites pour les fascistes !)


Préparation inter-orga


Après avoir présenté pourquoi c'est important et vital de s'opposer au Rassemblement Nazional, nous avons présenté la situation du congrès / meeting du RN à Orléans et d'où en est la préparation de la mobilisation anti-fasciste nationale !


Nous avons discuté stratégie et amendé une proposition de visuel d'appel à se mobiliser les 24 et 25 octobre à Orléans depuis partout.


Continuons à préparer la défaite du RN !


Ensemble nous avons décidé de créer des groupes inter-orga pour organiser

Artikel von Ellen Nebel vom 01.10.2018 in Neues Deutschland online

author: antifa
title: JUNG. DIGITAL. ORGANISIERT. Aufstieg und Fall der Jungnazi-Gruppe ‚Deutsche Jugend Voran‘
content:
Die erstarkende rechte Jugendbewegung, die sich überall bemerkbar macht, auf Social Media, im Kiez, bei CSDs, wirft viele Fragen auf: Wer sind diese jungen Neonazis? Wie sind sie organisiert? Was sind ihre ideologischen Ankerpunkte? Und vor allem: Was tun wir dagegen?


Diese Broschüre ist das Ergebnis antifaschistischer Recherche der letzten beiden Jahre. Der Fokus liegt auf Berliner Jungneonazigruppen und insbesondere der „Deutschen Jugend Voran“ (DJV). Auch wenn diese Struktur mittlerweile weniger präsent ist, war sie die erste Berliner Gruppe der rechten Jugendbewegung, die sich 2024 bundesweit formierte. An der DJV lässt sich das Phänomen beispielhaft erklären. Denn obwohl sich die Gruppenzusammensetzungen und Labels sich ständig verändern, bleibt das Kernproblem bestehen.


Unser Ziel ist es, Rechercheerkenntnisse und Strategiedebatten zu verschriftlichen, um sie möglichst vielen Antifas zugänglich zu machen und so Inspiration für antifaschistische Interventionen zu liefern.


Zu Beginn steht eine Chronik, die Aktivitäten von extrem rechten Jugendgruppen aus Berlin vom Juli 2024 bis Mai 2026 dokumentiert.


Daran schließt sich die Analyse der Struktur an, in der sich die Jungneonazis organisieren.


Das nächste Kapitel widmet sich der dahinterstehenden Ideologie und der Frage, warum die rechte Jugendbewegung gerade jetzt so präsent ist.


Darauf folgt ein kritischer Blick auf die staatliche Reaktion und den Gerichtsprozess gegen den DJV-Anführer Julian Milz.


Abschließend ziehen wir Bilanz, welche antifaschistischen Strategien in den letzten Jahren genutzt wurden und welche Handlungsmöglichkeiten sich uns bieten, um den Rechten entgegenzutreten.


Besprecht die Broschüre in euren Gruppen, bildet Banden und macht Pläne!


Download der Broschüre auf:

https://antifa-berlin.info/recherche/1915-broschre-jung-digital-organisiert-aufstieg-und-fall-der-jungnazi-gruppe-deutsche-jugend-voran-erschi

title: Quelques tags pour Gino, Zaid, Maja et les autres
content:
Soutien à Gino, Zaid, Maja, aux inculpé-es de Lyon et à toustes les autres.


Suite à l'annonce du verdict de la Cour d'Appel confirmant l'extradition de Gino vers l'Allemagne et à l'appel aux actions de soutien en sa faveur, un groupe organisé à décider de participer à la visibilisation de la répression des camarades pourchassé-es et enfermé-es pour leurs actions et leurs convictions politiques.


Parmi les plus médiatisés, le procès Antifa Ost continue en Allemagne, des camarades de l'affaire Budapest sont poursuivi-es en Allemagne et en Hongrie et les inculpé-es de Lyon sont enfermé-es en attendant leur jugement dans l'affaire Quentin. Un point commun : des personnes qui ont décidé de s'organiser pour se défendre face à la vermine fasciste la plus active en s'en prenant à leurs membres physiquement pour les empêcher d'agir.


Le fascisme n'est qu'un stade du capitalisme et le spectre de l'extrême droite ne doit pas nous faire oublier que ceux qui permettent leur ascension inquiétante en France et en Allemagne sont la classe politique institutionnelle allant des Verts/du

PS

 à la droite dite «

 

républicaine

 

». Nous sommes solidaires de toute action visant à freiner cette progression, qu'il s'agisse de brûler un local

PS

 ou de tabasser un nazi dans la rue. Il est plus que nécessaire aujourd'hui, à moins d'un an du cirque électoral habituel, de mettre en place des formes d'organisation collectives et autonomes : groupes d'autodéfense, comités de quartiers, assemblées locales mais aussi l'acquisition, par quelque moyen qui soi, de lieux et de moyens matériels. Face à ces formes d'organisation, la répression policière et judiciaire a rarement frappé aussi fort. Soyons solidaires de celleux qui s'y retrouvent confronté-es car iels n'ont pas leur place dans la logique capitaliste : sans-papier, fraudeur-se, voleur-se à l'étalage, cambrioleur-se et/ou tabasseur-se de faf etc. (quelques exemples)


Devant l'ampleur de la tâche à réaliser, quelques tags dans un quartier peuvent sembler dérisoire. Mais, nous y voyons 2 utilités. Premièrement, la présence à répétition sur plusieurs lieux de passages fréquentés peut interpeller les passant-es et pousser quelques personnes à s'informer sur ce sujet et ces affaires autrement que par les médias dominants. Deuxièmement, ce type d'opération peut être une première étape, un entraînement, une manière de gagner en confiance et en compétences en vue de réaliser d'autres actions plus ambitieuses : sabotage, attaques diverses etc.


En tout cas, nous pensons que c'est à la portée de beaucoup de personnes (attention aux caméras et aux voitures banalisées de flic la nuit) et nous préférerons toujours montrer notre solidarité ainsi plutôt qu'en repostant une story instagram avant de retourner à un train-train quotidien confortable.


Espérons que cette action puisse participer à soutenir Gino, Zaïd, Maja, Lina, les lyonnais-es et les autres. Des camarades.

title: Cezasızlık her yerde
content:
Son dönemde Orta Doğu Teknik Üniversitesinde (ODTÜ) gündeme gelen cinsel şiddet ve saldırı vakaları, Türkiye’de uygulanan cezasızlık politikalarının yaşamın birçok alanında görünür hale geldiğini gösteriyor. Haklarında şiddet iddiaları olan ODTÜ Elektrik ve Elektronik Mühendisliği bölümü öğrencisi Y. E. Ö. ve aynı üniversitenin Biyolojik Bilimler Bölümü araştırma görevlisi İ.K.Ö. hakkında mağdurların başlattıkları yargı süreci devam ediyor. Konuştuğumuz ODTÜ öğrencileri, yargının işlevsizliğinin üniversite ortamında güvensizliğe sebep olduğunu ifade ediyor. İ.K.Ö. için ODTÜ'de açılan soruşturmanın aylardır sonuçlanmaması ise, öğrenciler tarafından tepkiyle karşılanıyor.

ODTÜ’de kadın ve LGBTİ alanında çalışmalar yürüten Toplumsal Cinsiyet Çalışmaları Topluluğu yaşanan olaylara dair iktidarın politikalarını işaret etti:

“İktidarın artan cezasızlık politikalarını artık kampüsümüzde de net bir şekilde hissedebiliyoruz. Bugün bu iki ayrı vaka birbirinden bağımsız, münferit olaylar olarak değerlendirilmemeli. Her iki mağdur kadının da ortaya koydukları irade bizim bu vakaları görmemizi sağladı fakat okulumuzda hâlâ bilmediğimiz taciz ve şiddet olayları bulunuyor. Biz bu vakaların iktidarın izlediği politikalar ve atanmış rektörün de kampüsümüzdeki yönetiminin bir sonucu olduğunu vurgulamak istiyoruz. Biyolojik Bilimler Bölümü’nde yaşanan süreç bize açıkça gösteriyor ki hakkında darp, ısrarlı takip ve cinsel istismar iddiaları bulunan bir bölüm asistanının öğrencilerle ve kampüsle bağı korunuyor. İktidarın cezasızlık politikaları, rektörlüğün tutumu ve failin babasının savcı oluşuyla beraber görüyoruz ki mağdur değil, fail korunuyor. Faillere kampüste hâlâ alan tanınıyor. Herhangi bir yaptırım uygulanmıyor. Bu cezasızlık başka olaylar için faillere cesaret veriyor ya da mağdurun konuşmasını engelliyor.”

Toplumsal Cinsiyet Çalışmaları Topluluğu mücadelenin devam edeceğini söylerken taleplerini de sıraladı: “ODTÜ’de öğrenciler buna karşın sessiz kalmıyor yürüyüşlerle, basın açıklamalarıyla ve imza kampanyalarıyla bu hukuksuzluğun karşısında bir mücadele örüyor. Bunlara karşın güvenli kampüs, faillerin cezalandırılması ve cinsel tacizi önlemek adına verilen eğitimlerin zorunlu hale getirilmesi taleplerimizi kampüsün her yerinde yükseltmeye devam edeceğiz. Güvenli kampüsü ellerimizle kuracağız.”

Y. E. Ö. davasına ilişkin konuştuğumuz bir ODTÜ öğrencisi: “Refika Aksoy Yurdu'nda konaklayan bir kadın ve ODTÜ'lü bir öğrenci olarak, failin adli tıp raporuna ve çeşitli delillere rağmen yurdumuzda kalmaya devam etmesinden büyük bir rahatsızlık duyuyorum. Kendi güvenliğimize dair endişelerimiz hiçe sayılıyor ve önlem taleplerimiz reddediliyor. Yürüyüş ve basın açıklamalarında oluşturduğumuz kamuoyu ısrarla görmezden geliniyor. Karma bir yurtta nitelikli cinsel saldırı suçundan yargılanan birinin kalmasına izin verilerek öğrencileri korumaya karşı çıkılıyor; yargıda sıkça karşımıza çıkan hukuksuzluk ve öğrencilerin haklı endişeleri yok sayılarak fail korunuyor. Kendi yaşam alanımızda bile güvende hissetmiyoruz. Bizim için değil, bize karşı çalışan bir yönetim var.”

Okul yönetiminin ve mahkemenin tutumunu eleştiren öğrenci “Oluşturmaya çalıştıkları korku iklimine teslim olmayacağız, fail hak ettiği cezayı alana ve yurt ve kampüsten uzaklaştırılana kadar sesimizi duyurmaya devam edeceğiz” sözlerini ekleyerek mücadeleye devam edeceklerini söyledi.

Bu iki sürece ilişkin Refika Aksoy yurdunda kalan başka bir öğrenci ise, okulda güvensiz hissetmeye başladıklarına vurgu yaptı: “ODTÜ’de okumaya başladığımda kampüsün görece güvenli olması, gece ya da gündüz kampüste rahatça hareket edebilmek benim için çok değerliydi. Kampüs, dışarıdaki güvensizlik hissinden bir nebze olsun uzaklaşabildiğim, kendimi daha özgür hissettiğim bir yerdi. Ancak nitelikli cinsel saldırı sanığı Y. E.Ö.’nün ODTÜ yurtlar bölgesinde barınabildiğini öğrenmek, bu güven duygusunu ciddi biçimde sarstı. Bunun hemen ardından Biyolojik Bilimler Bölümü’nde görev yapan İ.K.Ö. hakkındaki taciz iddialarını öğrenmek ise öfkemi daha da büyüttü. Çünkü üniversiteler yalnızca ders aldığımız, sınavlara girdiğimiz yerler değil; günümüzün çok büyük bir bölümünü geçirdiğimiz, yaşadığımız alanlar. title: Young woman from Piranshahr declared brain-dead after torture, sexual violence
content:
Niloufar Mojaver, a young woman from Piranshahr, has been declared brain-dead after being held for 12 days and subjected to severe torture and physical and sexual violence, the Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) has reported.


Mojaver's family have identified her suitor, Seyyed Ezzatoddin Seyyed-Taheri, as responsible for the crime and have filed a formal complaint against him. They said he fled after taking Mojaver to a medical centre and remains at large.


Mojaver lived with her mother and two younger brothers and had begun working at her mother’s workplace to help support the family.


It was there that she met Seyyed-Taheri, who, according to her family, tried to gain her trust and persuade her to marry him by promising to improve her living conditions and help resolve her family’s problems. Her mother opposed the marriage.


Around two weeks before the incident, Mojaver left home and disappeared. Her family said she was held at an unknown location for 12 days, during which she was subjected to severe torture and physical and sexual abuse.


On 31 August, after her condition severely deteriorated, Seyyed-Taheri took her to a medical centre in a village in Piranshahr.


Medical staff, who found her in a critical condition, immediately transferred her by ambulance to Imam Khomeini Hospital in Piranshahr.


Following specialist examinations, doctors declared Mojaver brain-dead as a result of a severe blow to the head and multiple injuries.


After doctors concluded that there was no hope of recovery, her family agreed to donate her organs to patients in need.


According to the family, Seyyed-Taheri fled near the Piranshahr road police station while Mojaver was being taken to hospital, claiming that he was going to collect identification documents.


Despite the family filing a formal complaint with the judicial authorities, no information has been released about Seyyed-Taheri’s whereabouts or the progress of the investigation.

author: Unknown
title: Kadını öldürmeye teşebbüs etti, iddianame bile yazılmadı!
content:
Türkiye’de erkek şiddeti, kadına yönelik şiddet neden azalmıyor? Bu soruya verilecek en net yanıtlardan biri hiç kuşkusuz yargının cezasızlık politikası.


Peki nedir bu cezasızlık politikası? Feminist hareketin “Erkek adalet değil, gerçek adalet” diye sloganlaştırdığı meselenin özü tam olarak nereye dayanıyor? 


İsterseniz bunu kâğıt üzerindeki süslü maddelerden değil, somut bir şiddet vakası üzerinden adım adım irdeleyelim.


Yoğun bakıma alındı


S.T. isimli erkek, Aralık 2025’te Bodrum’da yaşayan komşusu G.E.’ye öldürmeye teşebbüs eti, bıçakla saldırdı. 


Saldırı sonucunda G.E.'nin vücudunda çoklu kesikler, iç kanama, kas ve sinir yaralanmaları ile acil müdahale gerektiren ağır tendon ve sinir kesikleri oluştu. Öyle ki Adli Tıp Kurumu raporuyla da sabit olduğu üzere bu saldırı "kasten yaralama" değil, hayati tehlike içeren ağır bir şiddet eylemiydi.


14–15 Aralık 2025'te G.E. yoğun bakıma alındı. Hayati tehlikesinin devam ettiği bu süreçte tıbbi stabilizasyonu sağlandı.


16 Aralık’ta yaralanmaların ciddiyeti ve boyutu nedeniyle G.E., İzmir’e sevk edildi. Burada tendon, sinir ve kas onarımları için ağır mikrocerrahi operasyon geçirdi.


İlgili tıbbi raporlar, tutanaklar ve diğer tüm resmi belgeler eksiksiz düzenlendi. Bu belgelerin tamamı, saldırının ağırlığını ve hayati tehlikeyi net bir şekilde ortaya koyuyordu.


Nihayetinde Bodrum Cumhuriyet Savcılığı tarafından soruşturma başlatıldı ve şüpheli S.T. tutuklandı.


Peki tutuklandı da ne oldu? Bu sırada yargı mercileri ne yapmalıydı, neyi yapmadı?


Aksayan soruşturma ve cezasızlık süreci


Aralık 2025 ile Nisan 2026 arasındaki soruşturma sürecinde tam anlamıyla bir ihmaller zinciri. Mesela, görgü tanıkları olmasına rağmen tanık ifadeleri alınmadı. Mesela, karşı tarafın birbiriyle çelişkili ifadeleri olmasına rağmen soruşturma derinleştirilmedi.


Olay anına dair video kayıtları araştırılmadı, incelenmedi. Soruşturma dosyasında bir türlü iddianame hazırlanmadı. Haliyle bir duruşma tarihi bile belirlenmedi.


Ve sonuç olarak 7 Nisan 2026’da, yani saldırıdan yaklaşık 4 ay sonra şüpheli S.T. tahliye edildi.


Tahliye sonrası ne oldu dersiniz? 


Saldırının tekrarlanma ihtimali nedeniyle G.E. için gerçek, somut ve çok yakın bir hayati risk oluştu. Belirsizlik ve korumasızlık durumu kadının yaşamını çekilmez hale getirdi.


Devam eden bu hayati risk nedeniyle G.E., 6284 sayılı Kanun kapsamında Aile Mahkemesine başvurdu. Mahkemeden, şüpheli hakkında uzaklaştırma kararı verilmesi, elektronik kelepçe takılması, mesafeli koruma tedbirinin uygulanması, varsa silahlarının toplatılması ve kararlara uymaması halinde zorlama hapsi uygulanacağına dair ihtar yapılması talep edildi.


Şüphelinin tahliye edilmiş olması ve iddianamenin hâlâ hazırlanmaması nedeniyle, bugün hâlâ uzaklaştırma kararının uzatılması, elektronik kelepçe tedbirinin devamı ile mesafe ve adres bazlı koruma tedbirlerinin sürdürülmesi için düzenli olarak uzatma taleplerinde bulunuluyor.


Kadını öldüresiye döven, bıçakla ağır şekilde yaralayan erkek şu anda ev hapsinde. Kadın ise koruma kararı bittikçe adliye koridorlarında yeni başvurular yapmak zorunda bırakılıyor.


Aradan neredeyse bir yıl geçmesine rağmen iddianame hâlâ hazırlanmadı. Hazırlanmadığı gibi soruşturma hâlen "basit yaralama" üzerinden yürütülüyor.


Oysa G.E.’nin avukatı

Sena Yazıbağlı Selanik

, soruşturmanın yaralama suçundan değil, "kasten öldürmeye teşebbüs" suçundan ilerletilmesi ve iddianamenin bu suçlamayla yazılması gerektiğini vurguluyor.


Avukat Selanik, dosyadaki tabloyu şu sözlerle özetliyor: “Hâlen tanıklar dinlenmedi. Aradan geçen bu zaman, ciddi anlamda sağlıksız, mağdur için adil olmayan bir soruşturmaya ve delil karartmaya yol açabilir.”


Bir yıldır dinlenmeyen o tanıkların zaman geçtikçe olayı unutması, ayrıntıları kaçırması mümkün değil mi?


Bir kadın, kendisini öldürmeye teşebbüs etmiş bir erkekten korunmak için daha ne yapacak? Yargının harekete geçmesi için bir kadının daha hayatını kaybetmesi mi gerekiyor?


(EMK)

author: Mag
title: Rassismus, Sexismus und ein Klima der Angst bei der Basler Polizei – nun wissenschaftlich belegt
content:
Dossier


„

Was die unabhängige Personalbefragung der Kantonspolizei Basel-Stadt über die Zustände im Korps aussagt, ist katastrophal: eine Kultur der Angst, eine veraltete Macho-Kultur, ein totaler Vertrauensverlust. (…) Markus Schefer, der Professor für Staats- und Verwaltungsrecht an der Uni Basel ist die erste gewählte Telefonnummer von Journalist*innen, wenn es eine Debatte über das Vorgehen der Polizei bei Demos gibt – er war beauftragt worden, die schiefe Personallage der Polizei zu untersuchen. Unterstützt wurde er von Claudia Puglisi, einer Polizeidirektor*in aus Niedersachsen, die bei der Präsentation neben ihm sass – ihr besorgt wirkender Blick spiegelte die Drastik der Ergebnisse wider. Denn an heftig negativen Begrifflichkeiten mangelt es im 42-seitigen Dokument sicherlich nicht.  (…) Die Kritik konzentriert sich auf Polizeikommandant Martin Roth. Er ist medial angeschlagen, seit linke Politiker*innen im Frühjahr 2023 wegen des

Gummischrot-Einsatzes der Frauentags-Demo


 seinen

Rücktritt


 forderten

…“

Artikel von David Rutschmann vom 21. Juni 2024 in bajour


 („Kein Lodern, ein Flammen“) – u.a. wurden Polizistinnen wurden in «fi**bar» oder «unf**kbar» unterteilt… Siehe dazu mehr Infos:


Das Gummischrot war illegal: Das Basler Appellationsgericht rügt die Polizei wegen eines Einsatzes gegen den feministischen Kampftag 2023


„Jahrelang war es so selten wie eine Fasnacht im Sommer, dass Basler Gerichte der Basler Polizei Grenzen setzen. Das ändert sich glücklicherweise gerade (…). Schritt für Schritt weist die Justiz ein entfesseltes Korps in die Schranken. Das neuste Urteil des Appellationsgerichts, das der WOZ exklusiv vorliegt, ist diesbezüglich ein Meilenstein. Darin erklärt das Gericht das Abfeuern von Gummischrot in eine Menschengruppe, von der keine konkrete Gefahr ausgeht, als illegal. Einen Klassiker der Basler Demobekämpfung. (…) Beurteilt hat das Gericht den Polizeieinsatz gegen den feministischen Kampftag am 8. März 2023. Damals versammelten sich rund 250 Personen vor der Universität. Und wurden, als sie sich in Bewegung setzen wollten, eingekesselt. Kurz darauf begannen die Polizist:innen, mit Gummischrot auf die Demonstrant:innen zu feuern. Doch nur die ersten drei Salven, so das Appellationsgericht, waren verhältnismässig. Diese erfolgten, als sich der Demozug in Richtung der Polizeikette bewegte. Die weiteren Salven waren rechtswidrig. (…) [S]elbst wenn der Mindestabstand eingehalten worden wäre, so das Gericht, hätte das den Gummischroteinsatz nicht gerechtfertigt. Dieser sei rechtswidrig gewesen (…)  In den weiteren Punkten des Urteils zeigt sich dann allerdings, dass auch das Basler Appellationsgericht alten Gewohnheiten nachhängt und noch immer gerne die Argumentation der Polizei übernimmt: Bei der Personenkontrolle sollen Polizistinnen mehreren Demonstrant:innen in die Unterhosen gegriffen haben. Die Polizei bestreitet dies – und das Gericht stellt sich auf ihre Seite. Die objektive Beweislast liege bei den Kläger:innen. In der dritten wichtigen Frage des Urteils geht es um die Rechtmässigkeit des Polizeikessels. Mit einer abenteuerlichen Begründung wischt das Appellationsgericht ein Urteil des Europäischen Gerichtshofs für Menschenrechte (EGMR) vom Tisch, das Anfang 2024 verlangte, dass ein solcher Kessel nicht ohne genau festgelegte Rahmenbedingungen möglich sei, etwa was die Dauer betreffe. In Basel ist das bloss rudimentär geregelt. Mehr sei auch nicht nötig, befindet das Gericht geradezu anmassend: «Diese für eine polizeiliche Technik wie die Einkesselung aussergewöhnlich hohen Anforderungen können für die Schweiz nicht verbindlich sein.» Es reiche aus, dass im Polizeigesetz allgemeines polizeiliches Handeln und Personenkontrollen geregelt seien – auch wenn der Kessel nicht explizit vorkommt. Constanze Seelmann, die die Demonstrant:innen rechtlich vertritt, wird in deren Auftrag den Entscheid ans Bundesgericht weiterziehen. «Das Appellationsgericht hat sich nicht richtig mit dem EGMR-Urteil befasst. Die Schweiz braucht aber ein Grundsatzurteil, ob und falls ja, unter welchen Umständen ein Polizeikessel zulässig ist.» (…) Wie leichtfertig in Basel eingekesselt wird, zeigte sich an der Palästina-Solidemo vergangenen Samstag. (…) Die Demonstrant:innen mussten bis zu zehn Stunden im Kessel ausharren. Dazu ging die Polizei mit Schäferhunden und Pfefferspray auf Personen los, die sich nicht rechtzeitig aus dem gesperrten Perimeter entfernten oder entfernen konnten. Immerhin …

author: Equality Now
title: Commemorating and celebrating Gloria Steinem: The life and legacy of a feminist trailblazer
content:
3rd September 2026


Commemorating and celebrating Gloria Steinem: The life and legacy of a feminist trailblazer


9 min read


The world has lost an extraordinary champion for equality, and Equality Now has lost a beloved friend, mentor and member of our global family.


Gloria Steinem, the pioneering writer, feminist organiser and political activist, passed away at her New York City home on September 2, 2026, at age 92. For more than half a century, she helped shine a light on women’s rights and gave a voice to generations of women’s beliefs around what was possible for themselves and for each other. 


For Equality Now, Gloria’s loss is deeply personal. Our organisation was founded in her home and she stood alongside us from our earliest days, sharing her voice, wisdom, time and encouragement with extraordinary generosity. She was curious about women around the world, shaped especially by her formative years in India post-college.


“Gloria believed in the beauty of shared power. She used her own powerful voice to make space for millions of women’s voices and generations have stepped into their agency because she did. Her legacy is not only the world she shaped but is embedded in all of us who believe in that vision and continue to strive to achieve it,” said

Mona Sinha

, Chief Executive Officer of Equality Now.


“The world has lost one of its best, and I have lost someone who has been a north star in my own life. I first met Gloria when I was a student at Smith College but was blessed to come to know the woman behind her words and activism. What stays with me is her unconditional love of her chosen family, her extraordinary generosity of spirit, her infectious laugh and her curiosity and zest for women’s lives. For someone whose voice carried so much influence, Gloria had the remarkable ability to make space for everyone. 


“She listened to everyone who came to her Talking Circles. She genuinely wanted to hear your thoughts, your experiences and what you were excited to learn. She had this amazing ability to make everyone feel that their stories, their voices and their ideas mattered, which they did. While I will miss her enormously, I know she walks beside us in every movement she has inspired, in women who have stood up for change and the friendships she has nurtured. Each one of us feels a little braver because she embodied what courage looks like.”


Gloria Steinem’s enduring support for Equality Now and women’s rights


Gloria’s involvement with Equality Now as an active supporter of its mission spans the organisation’s entire 34-year history. She played an integral role as a founding member of Equality Now’s Advisory Board in 1992, served on the Board of Directors from 2010 to 2016, in addition to being a Trustee of Equality Now’s UK entity between 2005 and 2019.


At the United Nations, Gloria publicly supported Equality Now’s ongoing 

Words and Deeds

 campaign, which for almost three decades has highlighted sex discriminatory laws around the world and called for legal reform.


She stood with us against Big Apple Oriental Tours, a New York company promoting sex tourism in Asia, helping press authorities to act in a campaign that ultimately led to legal action against the company and strengthened the case for tougher anti-trafficking laws. 


For over 50 years, Gloria fought to strengthen legal protections for women and girls in the US by championing the Equal Rights Amendment (ERA), which would amend the US Constitution to guarantee equal rights under the law, irrespective of sex. In recent years, she worked alongside Equality Now and the ERA Coalition, helping build pressure on the Biden administration to recognise the ERA.

President Biden declared the ERA the law of the land

 in January 2025.


She was also a longstanding co-chair of Equality Now’s annual Make Equality Reality Gala,  helping the organisation to raise much-needed resources to protect and promote the rights of women and girls globally. In recognition of her tireless work to make equality a reality for everyone, Equality Now honoured Gloria for her lifelong commitment at the 2014

Make Equality Reality Gala

. 


A remarkable life


Born on March 25, 1934, Gloria’s life was a testament to her unwavering commitment to advancing gender equality and in the power of people coming together to create change.


In the 1960s, she made her mark as a journalist covering women’s rights and other social issues. She went on to become one of …

author: Miriam Lafontaine
title: Inukjuak man accused of murder was ordered to not contact victim
content:
The Inukjuak man charged with first-degree murder for the death of his partner Elisabeth Qumak had been under a court order to not contact her when she was found dead inside a home in the community. 


Police

found

 the 41-year-old woman with stab wounds on Aug. 24, after Charlie Palliser arrived at the community’s police station to report he had committed a crime. She was pronounced dead at a local health centre.


The 45-year-old already faced charges for a break and enter and assault at Qumak’s home on July 17, court documents reveal. He was released on July 22 with conditions, including that he refrain from contacting her.


The Nunavik Police Service declined to comment on what happened on July 17, saying the investigation has since been handed over to provincial police in Quebec.


When reached by Nunatsiaq News, Quebec police also declined to comment.


Palliser had 

also given a curfew and was expected to attend social services meetings as well as activities organized by non-profit Saqijuq at least twice a month.


According to its website, the organization provides “alternatives to incarceration” by “promoting healthy lifestyles, strengthening cultural connections, and rehabilitating individuals.” It offers activities such as hunting, fishing and camping and workshops revolving around Inuit values and traditions. 


Nunatsiaq News asked Saqijuq if Palliser took part in any of their programs but has yet to hear back.


A Montreal-based coalition

of feminists against domestic violence

 has so far recorded 17 suspected

femicides in the province since the beginning of this year.


The figure is higher than what’s commonly reported in the media because the group monitors gender-based violence in situations that exclude romantic relationships, general co-ordinator Julie Antoine said in an interview. 


“It often happens that men are under no contact orders after a separation that they ultimately end up committing a femicide. Either the crime happens when the woman announces she wants to leave him, or the crime happens happens after an order is issued,” she said.


In about half of these 17 cases, she said, the group

 confirmed that the accused had previously been charged with a violent crime. 


“The state is falling in its role of protecting women, and it’s evident when you see that a high percentage of individuals involved in femicide cases were already known to the justice system,” Antoine said.


Palliser’s next court appearance is scheduled for Dec. 14.

author: Saneze Tshayana, Ana Stevenson, and Monica G. Fernandes
title: Wathint’ abafazi 70 years on
content:
The year 2026 marks the 70

th

 anniversary of the 1956

Women’s March

 against extending the

dompas

 to the black women of South Africa. Every August, the commemoration of Women’s Month highlights the inheritances and

unfinished legacies

 of women’s anti-apartheid resistance. This Women’s Month, it is timely to reflect on the legacies of women’s activism in South Africa over 70 years and more.


FEDSAW members in anti-Apartheid meeting


Organised by the

Federation of South African Women

 (FEDSAW), the 1956 Women’s March was a multiracial mass demonstration against pass laws. An estimated 20,000 women descended on Pretoria’s Union Buildings, presenting 14,000 petitions to

Prime Minister J.G. Strijdom

. Established in 1954, FEDSAW’s leadership, under luminaries such as

Lilian Ngoyi

,

Helen Joseph

,

Rahima Moosa

, and

Sophia Williams

, was particularly significant.


Previous women’s organising had arisen within the increasingly strict racial boundaries of the colonial and apartheid state. In 1913,

Charlotte Mannya Maxeke

 had led the

women’s anti-pass campaign

 in Bloemfontein, in the then Orange Free State. This led to the establishment of the

Bantu Women’s League

, which later became the

African National Congress

(ANC)

Women’s League

 in 1948. Similarly, the

Black Sash

, established in 1955, was an organisation of white women, bringing English-speaking women together with a smaller group of Afrikaans-speaking women. Alongside FEDSAW, these anti-apartheid resistance organisations were represented at the Women’s March.


The freedom song ‘

Wathint’ abafazi

, Strijdom!’, with the words ‘

Wathint’ abafazi, wathint’ imbokodo, uzu kufa!

’ (‘You strike a woman, you strike a rock, you will be crushed!’), featured at the 1956 protest. The

political slogan

 ‘

Wathint’ abafazi, wathint’ imbokodo

’ would become one of the liberation movement’s most enduring phrases, ricocheting across its posters and popular culture over the next four decades.


Yet, the slogan’s continued ubiquity into the twenty-first century belies the unevenness with which women’s activism has been recorded and remembered. Often invoked in popular memory, women’s activism has too often been marginalised against a celebration of men’s leadership, armed struggle, and formal political institutions.


A 2025

Special Issue

 of the

South African Historical Journal

, edited by Monica G. Fernandes and Ana Stevenson, centres women’s fight against apartheid. Spotlighting individuals and organisations, authors explore Ngoyi’s

urban roots

 and Williams’ formative experiences in the

youth movement

; uncover lesser known figures such as

Vesta Smith

 and

Joyce Piliso-Seroke

; consider Jewish social scientists Hilda Kuper and Ellen Hellmann’s

relationship

 with  scholar-activists of colour Fatima Meer and Regina Gelana Twala; revisit

Black internationalism

, the

Black Sash

, and the

ANC Women’s Section

; and critique

post-1994 literature

 about women’s experiences in the struggle.


This 70

th

 anniversary also offers a timely opportunity to consider women’s continuing activism towards realising the rights guaranteed in the 1996

Constitution

, 30 years later. Thanks to the efforts of various women’s groups as South Africa democratised, gender rights were enshrined in the final Constitution: in the

Bill of Rights

, gender is named as one of a slew of identifiers in anti-discriminatory legislation. However, the guarantees of gender equality have not gone unopposed, seen in South Africa most tellingly through the perniciously

high rates

 of men’s abuse of women, an enduring and insidious issue, more than 30 years into this democracy.


Legally, according to this Constitution, the status of South African women should be indisputable, protected as they are by gender-specific legislation against discrimination. Paradoxically, however, the ubiquity of men’s abuse of women, particularly in the context of intimate partner relationships, shatters any visions of constitutional equality.


Despite multiple

Presidential Summits

 dedicated to gendered violence, the drafting of the

National Strategic Plan on Gender-Based Violence and Femicide

 in 2020, and the establishment of the

Gender-Based Violence and Femicide (GBVF) Response Fund

, high rates of gendered violence continue to plague twenty-first century South Africa. This is the legacy of the historical and continuing disregard of women’s activism: where …

author: CMI Argentina
title: Rosario: movilización contra los femicidios y en reclamo de la emergencia en violencia de género
content:
Las organizaciones decidieron movilizarse luego de que se conocieran tres femicidios en 15 días.


Foto: Aire Libre- Rosario


Escuchar el reporte de Darío Uliassi desde Aire Libre Radio Comunitaria.


Concentraron este miércoles a las 17 frente a la Municipalidad de Rosario y finalizaron con un acto en la puerta de la sede de Gobernación de la provincia en la ciudad.


De la movilización participaron organizaciones feministas, sociales y políticas que se expresaron en contra de la violencia machista y reclamaron justicia por los femicidios.


En la provincia de Santa Fe se registraron más de 30 femicidios en lo que va del año. Además, se contabilizaron 10 víctimas más que en el mismo período del año pasado.


“Paren de matarnos” fue la consigna que encabezó la movilización donde las organizaciones advirtieron por la suba de casos, que se profundizan con el desmantelamiento de las políticas de género en los distintos niveles del Estado.


En declaraciones a Aire Libre, Gabriela Sosa, referente del movimiento feminista Mujeres por la Matria Latinoamericana (Mumalá), exigió la sanción de una ley provincial que declare la emergencia en violencia de género y que se cumpla la ordenanza local que declaró la emergencia hace un tiempo.


“Hemos presentado proyectos para que se declare la emergencia en violencia de género en Santa Fe y también que se pueda aplicar aquella ordenanza de hace varios años que ya declaraba la emergencia en Rosario y que disponía de recursos que siguen estando pendientes”.


Foto: Aire Libre- Rosario


Sosa también denunció las consecuencias del desmantelamiento de políticas públicas: “Esta quita de recursos, a la par de los discursos de odios, comienzan a impactar que las mujeres cada vez denunciamos menos, un 9% de la víctimas habían denunciado a su agresor anteriormente”.


Y agregó: “Por supuesto faltan campañas de prevención, faltan que los medios de comunicación tengan pautas de los estados municipales, provinciales y nacionales para informar de qué hacer”.


Fuente:

https://agencia.farco.org.ar/2026/08/27/rosario-movilizacion-contra-los-femicidios-y-en-reclamo-de-la-emergencia-en-violencia-de-genero/

Indymedia Argentina Centro de Medios Independientes (( i ))

author: Rizomatica
title: Llenado del embalse de la central hidroeléctrica Los Lagos, un reconocimiento expreso de la violación a la debida diligencia por parte de Statkraft
content:
La confirmación de Statkraft refuerza la urgencia y la pertinencia de la queja presentada por el Aylla Rewe del Ngen Mapu Kintuantü ante las autoridades noruegas por posibles incumplimientos de las obligaciones de debida diligencia en materia de derechos humanos.


COMUNICADO DE PRENSA.


«Territorio del Pilmaykén, 26 de agosto de 2026. – Como Aylla Rewe del Ngen Mapu Kintuantü, recibimos con profunda preocupación la confirmación formal por parte de Statkraft de que concluyó el llenado del embalse del proyecto hidroeléctrico Los Lagos, en la cuenca del río Pilmaiquén.


Durante años hemos advertido públicamente sobre las consecuencias que este proyecto puede tener para nuestros derechos como pueblo Mapuche Williche, nuestra relación con el territorio, nuestra espiritualidad, nuestra cultura, nuestra memoriay nuestras formas de vida.


También es información pública que, dentro del territorio involucrado, existen espacios de profundo significado espiritual y cultural para nuestro pueblo y que en la zona se realizaron hallazgos arqueológicos y bioantropológicos de los cuales la empresa tenía conocimiento.


La empresa y las autoridades conocían estas preocupaciones antes de que se completara el llenado del embalse. Aun asi, la empresa decidió seguir adelante. La confirmación del llenado del embalse es una prueba flagrante de la violación a los estándares de debida diligencia corporativa en materia de derechos humanos y de la desatención a las voces y llamados reiterados de las comunidades.


Esta confirmación no resta importancia a las acciones legales que hemos impulsado. Por el contrario, confirma precisamente la urgencia y pertinencia de la queja que presentamos hace unas semanas ante la Autoridad de Consumo de Noruega, con el acompañamiento legal del Proyecto de Derechos Económicos, Sociales y Culturales (ProDESC) y de la Iniciativa para la Justicia Transnacional. (IJT), en la que solicitamos que se investigue si Statkraft cumplió adecuadamente con sus obligaciones de debida diligencia en materia de derechos humanos.


Para nosotros, trasladar elementos materiales no sustituye ni repara la relación espiritual, cultural y territorial de la que forman parte.


Como Aylla Rewe, hemos utilizado durante años las distintas vías legales e institucionales disponibles para exigir el respeto a nuestros derechos y que Statkraft cumpla con su obligación de debida diligencia.

Hemos participado e impulsado procesos relacionados con la consulta indígena, recurrido a instancias judiciales nacionales y presentado una queja ante el Punto Nacional de Contacto de Noruega por posibles incumplimientos de las Líneas Directrices de la OCDE para Empresas Multinacionales.


Ante la ausencia de una respuesta capaz de prevenir las afectaciones que veníamos advirtiendo, hace unas semanas nos vimos obligados a acudir nuevamente a las propias instituciones noruegas y presentar una queja al amparo de la Ley de Transparencia.

No llegamos a esta instancia como primera opción.

Llegamos después de años de utilizar mecanismos legales e institucionales para exigir que nuestros derechos fueran respetados antes de que el territorio fuera transformado.


Por eso, la confirmación del llenado del embalse vuelve la queja aún más urgente.

La debida diligencia en materia de derechos humanos no puede reducirse a cumplir procedimientos formales o a elaborar informes. Su función sustantiva es identificar los  riesgos, prevenir sus impactos, mitigarlos y actuar antes de que las afectaciones se materialicen.


Lo informado refuerza nuestra preocupación de que las advertencias de las comunidades y los riesgos para nuestros derechos no hayan sido atendidos de manera efectiva antes de que el proyecto avanzara y produjera transformaciones materiales en el territorio.


Ahora estamos documentando y verificando directamente el alcance de las afectaciones derivadas del llenado. Sin embargo, este proceso es sumamente complejo, pues, como es de público conocimiento, las comunidades no tienen acceso al sitio de construcción de la Central Los Lagos ni a sus zonas aledañas, ya que el área está resguardada por guardias privados de la empresa y por tanquetas apostadas en los caminos.


Esta situación confirma nuevamente que nuestro derecho de acceso a la información y a la participación en las decisiones que afectan nuestro territorio ha sido sistemáticamente vulnerado: ni las autoridades ni la empresa han garantizado su pleno ejercicio. Resulta especialmente grave que …

author: Mattilda Bernstein Sycamore
title: ACT UP in Louisiana Was Pragmatic, Bold, Creative. Let’s Learn From It.
content:
David W. Hylan’s new book Small Town Rage shines a light on ‘90s-era AIDS organizing in conservative Shreveport.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

Nearly four decades have passed since ACT UP (the AIDS Coalition to Unleash Power) started in New York in 1987 as a direct action activist group “united in anger and committed to direct action to end the AIDS crisis.”

The 1980s were a time of mass death and government inaction, and ACT UP responded with confrontational protests that disrupted business as usual to force change. ACT UP’s tactics have become legendary, but its swift growth into a movement with over 100 autonomous chapters in cities large and small across the U.S., as well as in Canada, Europe, and Australia, has largely disappeared from the public record. There are however several chapters that continue today, including in New York, Philadelphia, Paris, and London, and new chapters that have emerged in Pittsburgh, Cleveland, and Chicago to respond to draconian cuts in HIV/AIDS services and trans health care under the second Trump administration.

In Small Town Rage: Fighting Back in the Deep South, David W. Hylan shines the light on ACT UP Shreveport, which started in 1990 in a conservative Louisiana town far from the centers of institutional power. Based on dozens of interviews with ACT UP Shreveport participants that he conducted for his 2016 movie of the same name (co-directed with Raydra Hall), the book expands the narrative to show how activists in Shreveport organized in a hostile environment to transform the situation for people with HIV/AIDS.

In our current regressive political climate, which eerily echoes the conservative backlash of the 1980s and ‘90s (don’t forget that it was Ronald Reagan who first used the campaign slogan “Make America Great Again”), ACT UP Shreveport’s legacy of resistance in the Bible Belt couldn’t be more relevant. In the interview that follows, Hylan discusses covert and overt organizing strategies, conflicts within the group, coalition actions, and confronting AIDS organizations, religious bigotry, and the KKK.

Mattilda Bernstein Sycamore: When people first started publicizing ACT UP Shreveport meetings, it was done through existing relationships. Deborah Allen, one early member, made cards with the meeting time that people could hand discreetly across the table as an invitation to join. I’m struck both by the need for caution, and the intimacy in this encounter, and I wonder if you could speak to other innovations ACT UP Shreveport made to deal with the intense homophobia of Shreveport at the time.

David W. Hylan: The cards Deborah made really capture what organizing in Shreveport required at the time. You have to remember that visibility carried consequences. People could lose jobs, relationships with their families, their churches, even their housing. So they couldn’t necessarily organize the way ACT UP could in New York, where you could put up a poster announcing a meeting and expect people to show up.

A lot of ACT UP Shreveport’s early organizing depended on trust. One person knew another person who might be angry enough, frightened enough, or simply fed up enough to get involved. Those cards could be passed quietly from one person to another without forcing someone to publicly identify themselves. But what is interesting is that this caution existed alongside some very public activism.

Once ACT UP Shreveport decided to act, its members could be extraordinarily visible. They papered The Shreveport Times, protested public officials, challenged the medical establishment, confronted the Klan, blocked the Red River bridge, and used sidewalk chalk and flyers to put AIDS and gay people into spaces where Shreveport would have preferred not to see them.

So there was almost a dual strategy: protect people when they needed protection, but refuse to allow that fear to make the movement invisible. They learned how to operate within the culture they were confronting rather than simply importing an ACT UP model from somewhere else.

You write that in Shreveport, “Church wasn’t optional, it was cultural law.” And, “Religion was not just belief; it was enforcement.” So the judgment and condemnation from the pulpit was embedded in every interaction. How did ACT UP challenge this?

Religion in Shreveport was complicated because ACT UP wasn’t simply challenging …

author: Dominic Gutoman
title: Right(s) Up: Transfemicide as trans women rights violation
content:
Kierra Apostol. (Contributed photo)

Context: Transfemicide is a word used by trans-led organizations to define the pattern of killings of trans women and transfeminine people rooted in transphobia, misogyny, hatred, and systemic violence often compounded by intersecting forms of discrimination and marginalization

Human rights: Civil and political rights, economic, social, and cultural rights, gender justice

Rights-holder: Trans women and transfeminine people

Duty-bearer: Philippine government

MANILA – The Philippines has the most number of transgender women murder.

The Society of Trans Women of the Philippines (STRAP) raised this point at the launch of Project Kierra, a trans-led initiative that seeks to document the killings and campaign for justice.

The project was named after Kierra Apostol, an 18-year-old trans woman killed in June 2025.

“When it is not documented, it is easily erased in public memory,” STRAP Executive Director Vashti Ortego said. “We hope to transform not only a word, I hope that it will enter the vocabulary of the institutions and revisit their laws and policies.”

Read: Recent killings of trans women prompt groups to push for LGBTQIA protection

According to Trans Murder Monitoring, the Philippines had 107 documented trans women killings since 2009. In contrast, Singapore and Cambodia had 1; Thailand, 27; Indonesia, 13; Myanmar, 5; and Malaysia, 16.

Doms Cordero, co-author of the book Transfemicide in the Philippines published this year, noted that the number may even be higher since the cases are underreported and even misreported. One challenge they identified is the domestic reporting mechanisms remain limiting: the Philippine National Police’s reporting forms remain binary– with only male and female as their markers.

“Some of them are deadnamed even in reports. These are not legal documents. We seek to honor the lived experiences of trans women. They’re already dead, and we are killing them again (by using their legal name),” Cordero said, adding that they have not yet documented transgender women who even used the anti-Violence Against Women and Children (VAWC) desk of the Philippine National Police because of the fear of being misgendered.

Read: Brutal killing of trans woman in Caloocan prompts calls for investigation, passage of SOGIE bill

In 2025, the Commission on Human Rights (CHR) flagged that the pattern of trans killings in the Philippines is already a transfemicide. From 2025 to present, there are 15 documented trans women killings.

On January 15, 2025, Ren Tampus, a 35-year old beauty salon owner, died in hospital after being shot by a gunman who invaded one of her salons. Six days later, trans woman Shalani Dolina suffered a brutal killing. Her severed leg was found stored in an ice cooler, while her body was wrapped in a mattress.

Trans woman revolutionary Dahlia Supelanas was killed by the Philippine military, together with six other people in a clash, on April 27, 2025. While trans rights activist Ali Macalintal was shot several times inside her massage and spa clinic on June 23, 2025, in General Santos City.

Kierra Apostol, an eighteen-year-old trans woman, was found dead in a river two days after she had gone missing, with her body showing signs of physical assault. STRAP said that the suspect behind her killing was already arrested in September 2025.

Jerico Elliorate was killed by stabbing multiple times by a person she met at a party. Her killer then stole her wallet on August 14, 2025. A trans woman named Christine, who was also a 44-year-old therapist, was found dead inside a rented apartment in Valenzuela City, on September 22, 2025.

Another trans activist was killed at the hands of state forces. On April 19, 2026, Filipino American Kai Sorem was killed by the Philippine military, together with 8 civilians and 10 revolutionaries in a massacre in Toboso, Negros Occidental.

On June 20, 2026, 20-year-old trans woman Bella Lutap was found dead in an irrigation canal in Sitio Burnao, Zaragoza after being reported missing for three days. The Nueva Ecija police identified her ex-boyfriend as the primary suspect. He was arrested and charged with murder.

Teddy Federico, a trans woman, indigenous youth leader, and a barangay agricultural worker was found dead eight days after being reported missing, July 15, 2026. The investigation into her death is still ongoing.

title: Συγκέντρωση ενάντια στις πειθαρχικές διώξεις των εκπαιδευτικών του 3ου ΔΣ Ραφήνας, Παρασκευή 4/9, στο ΠΣΑΔΔΤ (Νηρηίδων 10), Αθήνα
content:
Τη Παρασκευή 4/9, στις 09.30, στο Πειθαρχικό συμβούλιο ανθρώπινου δυναμικού δημόσιου τομέα (ΠΣΑΔΔΤ Νηρηίδων 10), 12 εκπαιδευτικοί

 του 

3ου Δημοτικού Σχολείου Ραφήνας

 διώκονται στο

Πειθαρχικό Συμβούλιο Ανθρώπινου Δυναμικού Δημοσίου Τομέα (ΠΣΑΔΔΤ)

 για κατηγορίες όπως η «δυνητική αργία», παράβαση υπαλληλικού καθήκοντος και άρνηση εκτέλεσης καθηκόντων. Σύλλογοι Εκπαιδευτικών, οργανώσεις και τοπικές πρωτοβουλίες καλούν σε συγκέντρωση ενάντια στις διώξεις των εκπαιδευτικών, τις τρομοκρατικές πολιτικές του κράτους απένταντι στους/τις αγωνιζόμενους/ες εκπαιδευτικούς/ες και καλούν τους εργαζόμενους στην εκπαίδευση σε 3ωρη στάση εργασίας κατα τη διάρκεια της κινητοποίησης.


Καλέσματα:


Σύλλογος Εκπαιδευτικών Π.Ε. “Αλέξανδρος Δελμούζος”


Τ

ο Δ.Σ. του Συλλόγου μας καταγγέλλει με τον πλέον κατηγορηματικό τρόπο την πρωτοφανή και αυταρχική δίωξη των μελών του, εκπαιδευτικών, του 3ου Δημοτικού Σχολείου Ραφήνας.


Οι συναδέλφισσές μας παραπέμπονται στο Πειθαρχικό Συμβούλιο την Παρασκευή 4 Σεπτέμβρη με το ερώτημα της «δυνητικής αργίας», επειδή έπραξαν το αυτονόητο παιδαγωγικό τους καθήκον, υπερασπίστηκαν το δικαίωμα των μαθητών τους στη μόρφωση και διαμαρτυρήθηκαν για τις αντιεκπαιδευτικές συγχωνεύσεις τμημάτων και το στοίβαγμα των μαθητών τους, που έγιναν στο σχολείο τους ενώ είχε ξεκινήσει η σχολική χρονιά.


Η απόφαση της διοίκησης και του Υπουργείου να σύρουν τις συναδέλφισσες στο Πειθαρχικό με το ερώτημα της “δυνητικής αργίας” αποτελεί μια άθλια μεθόδευση οικονομικής, επαγγελματικής και ηθικής εξόντωσης. Αποδεικνύεται περίτρανα αυτό που λέγαμε πριν ένα χρόνο στα τέλη Αυγούστου όταν ψηφιζόταν στη Βουλή το νέο πειθαρχικό δίκαιο των Δ.Υ., ότι δεν είναι ένα κανονιστικό πλαίσιο αλλά ένα όπλο μαζικής τρομοκράτησης που επιστρατεύουν το ΥΠΑΙΘΑ και η κυβέρνηση, προκειμένου να επιβάλλουν σιγή νεκροταφείου στα σχολεία και να τσακίσει κάθε εστία αντίστασης απέναντι στον σχεδιασμό της για παραπέρα εμπορευματοποίηση και κατηγοριοποίηση των σχολείων, απέναντι στις περικοπές και συγχωνεύσεις τμημάτων και σχολείων. Άλλωστε είναι γνωστό πλέον ότι τα λεφτά για την παιδεία και την υγεία αποδίδονται στην ενίσχυση της πολεμικής οικονομίας.


Η επιβολή του καθεστώτος της δυνητικής αργίας —που στερεί βίαια από τον εκπαιδευτικό τη δουλειά του και το ψωμί της οικογένειάς του πριν καν δικαστεί— συνιστά ευθεία παραβίαση του τεκμηρίου της αθωότητας και θυμίζει μαύρες εποχές. Θέλουν να εξοντώσουν τις συναδέλφισσες παραδειγματικά για να φοβηθούν οι υπόλοιποι. Δεν θα τους περάσει!


Το εκπαιδευτικό κίνημα έχει αποδείξει ότι δεν σκύβει το κεφάλι. Η τρομοκρατία της αξιολόγησης, των συγχωνεύσεων και των πειθαρχικών διώξεων θα σπάσει πάνω στο τείχος της αλληλεγγύης μας. Αυτή είναι η λύση, όπως αποδείχθηκε και από τις πρώτες απαλλακτικές αποφάσεις για τους διωκόμενους συναδέλφους μας που υπερασπίζονται όπως και όλος ο κλάδος μας το τι και με ποιον τρόπο μαθαίνουν τα παιδιά μας στο σχολείο, για την παιδαγωγική υπόσταση των εκπαιδευτικών, για το δικαίωμα στην απεργία και τη διεκδίκηση.


Μπορούμε να τα καταφέρουμε από κοινού οι εκπαιδευτικοί, με τη στήριξη και των γονιών των μαθητών μας.


Απαιτούμε εδώ και τώρα:


 Να σταματήσουν αμέσως όλες οι πειθαρχικές διώξεις των εκπαιδευτικών στο 3ο ΔΣ Ραφήνας


 Να πεταχτεί αμέσως στα σκουπίδια το απαράδεκτο ερώτημα για θέση σε «δυνητική αργία».


 Να σταματήσει η βιομηχανία διώξεων, ο αυταρχισμός και οι απειλές της διοίκησης ενάντια στους μαχόμενους εκπαιδευτικούς.


Απαντάμε μαζικά – Στον αυταρχισμό αντιτάσσουμε την αλληλεγγύη!


Καλούμε όλους τους εκπαιδευτικούς, τους γονείς που το προηγούμενο διάστημα αγωνιστήκαμε μαζί τους για τα μορφωτικά δικαιώματα των παιδιών και τα σωματεία της Αττικής να δώσουν δυναμικό “παρών” την Παρασκευή 4/9 στις 9:30 στην κινητοποίηση έξω από το Πειθαρχικό Συμβούλιο Ανθρώπινου Δυναμικού Δημοσίου Τομέα (ΠΣΑΔΔΤ)Νηρηίδων 10 (περιοχήHILTON,τέρμα Μιχαλακοπούλου).


Ο Σ.Ε.Π.Ε. “Αλ. Δελμούζος”, προκειμένου να διευκολυνθεί η μαζική συμμετοχή των μελών, του κηρύσσει 3ωρη διευκολυντική στάση εργασίας από 9.00-12.00.


Ακόμα καλεί το Δ.Σ της Δ.Ο.Ε. να δείξει ακόμα μια φορά τη συμπαράσταση και την αλλυλεγγύη του στα διωκόμενα μέλη μας, κηρύσσοντας 3ωρη διευκολυντική στάση εργασίας και να παρευρεθεί στην κινητοποίηση.

title: Symbol of ‘Jin, Jiyan, Azadî’: ‘Braids woven with oak leaves’
content:
On the fourth anniversary of the ‘Jin, Jiyan, Azadî’ uprising, 17 women’s and human rights organizations issued a joint statement.


The statement was signed by numerous organizations, including KJAR, the PJAK Women’s Council, Jîna Academy, the Balochistan Shivar Organization and the International Platform of Democratic Women.


The statement emphasized that the movement had broken deeply rooted social taboos, marked a turning point in the political and social spheres, and placed women’s rights and human dignity at the heart of societal demands.


It stated that, over the four years since the uprising began, social awareness has undergone a transformation and women’s solidarity has emerged as one of its most significant achievements.


The unity of women from different ethnic and national backgrounds gave the movement considerable strength, the statement said, stressing that lasting, just and democratic change would not be possible without recognizing women’s rights and combating discrimination.


The statement also unveiled a shared symbol for this new phase of the struggle: “braids woven with oak leaves.”


According to the statement, the loose braid symbolizes freedom and courage, the tight braid represents solidarity and organization, while the oak tree symbolizes resistance against oppression and putting down roots.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Gloria Steinem, Feminist Icon & Ms. Magazine Co-Founder, Dies at 92
content:
Feminist icon Gloria Steinem has died at the age of 92. According to her Instagram page, she died Wednesday “at her home in New York City, surrounded by some of the many who loved her.” Steinem was a tireless advocate for the social, economic and political advancement of women. Steinem co-founded

Ms.

 magazine, the first major publication to be owned, run and written by women. She also helped found the National Women’s Political Caucus with a group of women including Shirley Chisholm, Betty Friedan and Fannie Lou Hamer. Before becoming a feminist icon, she served as director of the Independent Research Service, a nonprofit educational foundation secretly funded by the

CIA

. In 2013, she received the Presidential Medal of Freedom from President Barack Obama. She spoke with

Democracy Now!

 at the historic Women’s March in Washington, D.C., on January 21, 2017. We play an excerpt.

title: Khawla - A Trans Woman’s Letter to Trans Women
content:
Author

: Khawla

Title

: A Trans Woman’s Letter to Trans Women

Subtitle

: On struggle, resilience, love, and the trans women’s martial art.

Date

: 2026

Source

: Retrieved on 8-28-26 from https://pandemoniumdistro.noblogs.org/post/2026/05/28/a-trans-womans-letter-to-trans-women/


 Dear sister,


 I love you. I’m so sorry that the world is like this.


 I love you. I want you to be free to be yourself. To love and to live and to have and to hold.


 I love you. None of this is your fault. You deserve so much better.


 Juniper Blessing deserved so much better. Davonta Curtis deserved so much better. Eryka Caldwell deserved so much better.


 We deserve to live. We deserve to make our art. We deserve to dance, and sing, and create. We deserve to be soft and vulnerable. We deserve to feel loved, and safe, and treasured.


 Trans women are a treasure. We have always been a driving cultural force, whether the world was with us or against us. We have always brought so much light and color into the world.


 I love you. You and I are going to have to rip and tear to survive this. We are going to have to burn the world and tear down fortresses.


 Our enemies have made major strides in their plans to erase us. They surround us from every side.


 I know you see it too. I know you’re scared.


 I want to leave too. But I couldn’t do that to you. I couldn’t stomach to leave you here to fend for yourself.


 There are a lot of people who mean well towards us. A lot of people who really believe they would fight for us.


 But I have experienced enough to know we only have each-other. I have experienced enough to know that trans women throw the first brick and they hate us for it. I know that Black trans women pave the way when everyone else wants to give up and turn back.


 Where we’re going there’s no place for organizers and marshals. There’s no place for symbolic victories, good press, or witty signs.


 Where we’re going, we’re going to have to fight for our lives.


 So many of us are already fighting for our lives. V-coding in prisons, stalking, doxxing, harassment, assault, murder.


 Little egg middle schoolers are growing up in a world that makes it known it hates them. Trans children are killing themselves and the lawmakers know it and they celebrate it.


 You and I both know that they want us dead.


 I love you. You don’t deserve any of this. You did nothing wrong.


 I love you. It’s ok to be scared. But you have to get angry. You have to become powerful.


 I love you. When I go to the range, it’s for you. When I throw a stone, it’s for you. When I write, it’s for you.


 I love you. We are going to have to tear down fortresses to survive. We’re going to do it together.


 I’m not leaving you. I’ve got your back.


 We have got to get organized. We have got to get armed. We have got to have a strong defense. We have got to have a strong offense. We have got to get the knife off of our neck and onto theirs.


 Court decisions that rule favorably for our survival are not victories. They are luck at best. Victories are things we bring about by our own hand. Court decisions are something power bestows on us like a gift after reminding us of its intent to erase us.


 Our enemies are pushing at us from every angle. The courts occasionally get in the way by chance like a clumsy, bloated bureaucratic monster. The attacks on us do not stop. Our survival cannot depend on an institution that exists to serve our enemies and to serve a genocidal, carceral, settler-colonial empire.


 It has to depend on ourselves and each-other.


 You should own a gun and you should know how to use it and clean it. You should have trans women friends who do the same.


 If you cannot safely own a gun, support your trans women friends in being armed.


 Support them in training. Pack them lunch on range day.


 When you have a gun and know how to use it, it is a safeguard against the last hour. It is a safeguard for when the police come to your home to take you to a camp.


 When you have a gun and know how to use it, and your friends have guns and know how to use them, it becomes a capacity for strength and to project power. When you and your friends understand fire and maneuver, when you understand how to fight, it becomes a capacity for retaliation against power, a vehicle to secure victories like we haven’t seen before, the ability to put the enemy on the back foot, the ability to punish him for crimes he has committed against …
