author: Marina Amaral
title: O STF entrou nas eleições pra valer e não há inocentes nessa guerra
content:
Quer receber os textos desta coluna em primeira mão no seu e-mail? Assine a Newsletter da Pública, enviada sempre às sextas-feiras, 8h. Para receber as próximas edições,

inscreva-se aqui

.


A neutralidade da Justiça nunca foi uma característica brasileira, como sabem mulheres, pretos e pobres que já enfrentaram um tribunal – como réus ou como vítimas. Interesses econômicos, lealdade de classe ou gênero, preconceitos, e em alguns casos, corrupção, desequilibram a balança que deveria julgar todos os cidadãos com mesmo peso e medida. 


Esse é o papel principal do Supremo Tribunal Federal, guardião da Constituição, que pode corrigir erros das instâncias inferiores e declarar inconstitucionais medidas e leis do Legislativo ou do Executivo, como vimos tantas vezes no governo Bolsonaro. O que não significa imunidade contra distorções de juízo, como em qualquer tribunal, nem que os ministros individualmente não tenham seus próprios interesses políticos e econômicos, como foi escancarado nesta semana. 


Por isso as decisões coletivas, teoricamente tomadas por técnicos de excelência jurídica, são tão importantes para fazer valer a Constituição e a legalidade dos processos judiciais, prevalecendo as provas e os direitos dos réus, como ocorreu na

condenação de Jair Bolsonaro

, generais e outros golpistas pela 1a turma do STF por um placar de 4×1 em julgamento com transmissão ao vivo para todo mundo acompanhar.  


Por outro lado, os juízes do Supremo são indicados por políticos – os presidentes – e referendados por outros políticos, os senadores. A lealdade esperada pelos que os indicaram supera o critério técnico, e a representatividade social não existe, como prova a minguada presença de mulheres e de negros na história do tribunal. 


Alexandre de Moraes, ex-DEM e filiado ao PSDB quando foi indicado por Michel Temer para o STF, era seu amigo há mais de 20 anos e ocupou o cargo de ministro da Justiça em seu governo. Também agradava à base aliada no Congresso (leia-se centrão e extrema-direita), que meses depois de derrubar Dilma Rousseff “com Supremo com tudo”, estava preocupada com as denúncias da Lava Jato – das quais o próprio Temer seria alvo, depois do empresário Joesley Batista ter gravado um diálogo comprometedor com ele na garagem do Palácio Jaburu. 


André Mendonça, como todos sabem, foi indicado pelo presidente Jair Bolsonaro, de quem era ministro da Justiça, o que por si só não o compromete, como mostra a atitude de ministros indicados por Lula. Um exemplo gritante é o que ocorreu quando Lula estava preso e o ministro Dias Tóffoli, indicado por ele dez anos antes para o STF,

o proibiu de comparecer ao velório do irmão. 


O que não se pode esquecer, quando se pensa no motivo, forma e momento que Mendonça escolheu para tornar públicas as relações no mínimo impróprias de Alexandre de Moraes com o banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro, é que Mendonça está longe de ser neutro – ou ingênuo politicamente.

 Quando era ministro da Justiça de Bolsonaro, pediu à PF a abertura de inquéritos com base na Lei de Segurança Nacional da ditadura contra opositores políticos do presidente e até contra jornalistas. Também sob seu comando, o Ministério da Justiça produziu um dossiê contra 576 servidores e três professores universitários, identificados e monitorados por eles como integrantes do “movimento antifascista”, o que resultou em determinação do STF para suspender qualquer ato do Ministério da Justiça de produção ou compartilhamento de informações. A atuação do MJ foi qualificada como “uma afronta direta ao regime democrático” pela ministra Cármen Lúcia.


Com esse histórico, fica difícil imaginar que Mendonça agiu puramente no interesse da Justiça ao atropelar ritos internos e encomendar um relatório da PF, visando Moraes, Paulo Gonet (PGR) e Andrei Rodrigues (PF), no dia 24 de agosto com prazo de 72 horas para ser concluído, e levantar o sigilo na manhã de 1º de setembro, quando já estava sendo vazado pelo Estadão. O material, esmiuçado pela imprensa, é devastador, e coloca Moraes na posição de informante ou consultor jurídico do banqueiro, com imenso impacto para o STF, o país e para as eleições, que já vinham sofrendo interferência dos Estados Unidos. 


Se antes o ódio a Moraes era provocado sobretudo pela prisão dos golpistas, agora o lobby de Eduardo Bolsonaro e Paulo Figueiredo pode instrumentalizar politicamente as suspeitas de corrupção sobre o ministro, que já havia sido incluído na Lei Magnitsky pelo governo Trump, com …

author: hsa_oryx
title: IT’S BEEN A BUSY AUGUST
content:
Cub hunting, leveret hunting and stag hunting all started during August, while mink hunting has continued over the summer, meaning sab groups have been working hard, whilst tackling hot and dry weather conditions. The HSA as a collective has also been busy exposing blood sports; as well as working in the field to save lives we have continued to share regular articles and social media content.


August kicked off with sabs being assaulted by members of the Cottesmore Hunt who were attending a scheduled “fun ride”. Sabs were driven at by speeding vehicles and one attendee physically assaulted a sab, attempting to strangle them and break a camera.


The Cottesmore Hunt continued to crumble under the pressure as they turned up to a scheduled hound exercise event with no hounds and then failed to turn up at all to another “fun” ride. Furthermore, on the 24

th

 of August whipper in Max Logan appeared at Leicester Magistrates court and entered a not guilty plea for four charges of hunting a wild mammal with dogs. This upcoming season will be a telling one for this hunt who have been kept under scrutiny by Northants Hunt Sabs.


The Cottesmore Hunt are crumbling under the pressure


For the second time the Puckeridge and Essex Hunt have been issued a Community Protection Warning (CPW), following on from months of evidence of anti-social behaviour gathered by East Herts Sabs. Huntsman Rhys Matcham was also charged with illegal hunting and his court appearance was scheduled for the 4

th

 of August, however the case was discontinued as Matcham evades justice once again.


The Puckeridge and Essex Hunt secure themselves a second CPW

© East Herts Sabs


It’s not only the Puckeridge who are in trouble with the law. Will Bryer, Mitch Prosser and Anthony Tuck of the Duke of Beaufort Hunt entered not guilty pleas at Bristol Magistrate’s Court on the 5

th

 of August. These charges are in relation to the killing of a fox on the 20

th

 of December 2025 on the Duke’s Badminton Estate.


Sheffield Hunt sabs reported that Joshua Taylor, a hunt master at the Grove and Rufford Hunt has been charged with assault by beating and criminal damage after he attacked one of their sabs. This charge is in addition to those hanging over the Grove for huntsman Jacob Whalley and terrier man Ste Reynolds for interfering with an active badger sett.


Taylor used his quad to block a sab then ripped his bodycam from him and launched a violent assault


Continuing on with charges, West Midlands Hunt Sabs reported that ex hunt master and director Olivia Forsyth and hunt member Harry Sawyer have both been charged with Wilful Obstruction of the Highway.


On the 12

th

 of August sabs descended on the Yorkshire Dales National Park for the ‘glorious twelfth’. Despite the best efforts of North Yorkshire police who began scribbling out dispersal orders,

sabs succeeded in their mission

 and stopped the Coverdale shoot from blasting birds out of the sky.


In conjunction with this, throughout August, the HSA launched a series of articles exposing the shooting industry and the extent of the damage this blood sport is doing to the environment. Wiltshire Hunt sabs shared horrific scenes at the

Stockton shoot estate

 where there is an industrial size operation consisting of a bonfire full of dead charred birds breaching animal by-product regulations.


Mission complete: hunt sabs stopped the Coverdale shoot

© Newcastle Hunt Sabs


On more than one occasion sabs sent the Dove Valley mink and otter hounds packing as they were caught hunting, equipped with telescopic poles and a T-bar. This kind of equipment is used for dislodging mink or otter from places of refuge such as trees or other vegetation. The small group of miscreants soon packed up at the site of sabs as they are without a smokescreen for their illegal activity.


Dove Valley mink and otter hounds are sent packing

© Nottingham Hunt Sabs


Despite a Bluetongue outbreak raging through cattle and sheep in the south west the Quantock Staghounds were caught on Monday the 10

th

 of August attempting to hunt a stag with eight hounds, despite the law stating only two hounds can be used to flush a stag at one time. The stag hunt packs continue to blatantly exploit the loopholes within the law to terrorise stags in the south west.


On the 20

th

 of August sabs reported that the Quantock Staghounds had been out again tormenting a beautiful stag for four hours. He thankfully managed to evade capture …

author: Animal Rising Press
title: WOMAN TO SPEND 21 DAYS AND NIGHTS IN PIG FARROWING CRATE IN TRAFALGAR SQUARE
content:
This morning (01/09/26) Animal rights campaigner Michelle Farnham entered a pig farrowing crate outside the National Gallery in Trafalgar Square where she will remain for 21 days, as Animal Rising launches its campaign to end factory farming in Britain by 2040.

The action coincides with the release today of never-before-seen footage following a month in the life of Luna, a sow confined in a farrowing crate on a British factory farm. Animal Rising are calling for the release of Luna from Red Court Farm in Ipswich. [1]

For three weeks, Michelle will remain inside the crate day and night, experiencing a fraction of the confinement imposed on sows like Luna: pigs trapped in these crates are able to stand up and lie down, but are unable to turn around, causing intense physical and psychological suffering.

Journalists are invited to attend the installation in Trafalgar Square to interview and film Michelle inside the farrowing crate, as well as speak to Animal Rising spokespeople on location. Please contact press@animalrising.org or call +44 1225 29 6691 to arrange interviews.

Michelle Farnham will spend 21 consecutive days and nights inside a farrowing crate in Trafalgar Square, as part of a new installation launching Animal Rising's End Factory Farming campaign, which is calling on the UK Government to commit to ending factory farming by 2040 and publish a roadmap for the transition. [2]

Michelle Farnham will spend 21 consecutive days and nights inside a farrowing crate in Trafalgar Square, as part of a new installation launching Animal Rising's End Factory Farming campaign, which is calling on the UK Government to commit to ending factory farming by 2040 and publish a roadmap for the transition. [2]

The Government's Animal Welfare Strategy for England states that approximately 92% of indoor pig production systems continue to use farrowing crates, where pigs due to give birth and nursing piglets are confined for a month at a time, with commercial sows typically giving birth twice a year. [3]

title: Cruauté et infractions à l’abattoir de Perpignan
content:
Entre mai et juillet 2026, des caméras ont filmé ce qui se passe à l'abattoir de Perpignan. Des cochons frappés à coups de poing. Un opérateur qui enfonce son avant-bras dans l'incision de saignée d'un cochon encore conscient. Des moutons balancés par la toison et par les pattes. Des vaches et des moutons découpés alors qu'ils sont encore en vie.

Rien de tout cela n'est accidentel : le couloir des cochons est en angle droit, le box de contention des bovins n'immobilise pas assez les animaux pour un étourdissement précis. Et tout se passe sous les yeux des services vétérinaires de l'État, présents chaque jour d'abattage.

L214 porte plainte pour actes de cruauté et demande la fermeture immédiate de l'abattoir.

Aujourd'hui, vous pouvez agir en une minute en signant la pétition. Merci 🙏

Les images filmées entre mai et juillet 2026 dans l'abattoir de Perpignan montrent des cochons frappés à coups de poing, des moutons balancés par les pattes, des vaches et des moutons découpés alors qu'ils sont encore en vie.

Ces faits ne sont pas des accidents : les installations, les équipements de contention et les modes opératoires de cet établissement ne permettent pas de respecter la réglementation encadrant la mise à mort des animaux. Ils se produisent chaque jour d'abattage sous le contrôle des services vétérinaires de l'État.

Cet abattoir a été construit en 2015 avec 7,7 millions d'euros d'argent public, et reste dix ans plus tard incapable de tuer des animaux dans les conditions minimales exigées par la loi. Ce n'est pas un cas isolé : c'est la neuvième enquête de L214 en abattoir en deux ans.

Nous demandons au préfet des Pyrénées-Orientales la fermeture immédiate de l'abattoir de Perpignan.

Nous demandons à la ministre de l'Agriculture un audit de tous les abattoirs français, la publication des rapports d'inspection, et un moratoire sur la construction de nouveaux abattoirs : tant que l'État ne fait pas respecter la loi dans ceux qui existent, aucun nouvel abattoir ne devrait sortir de terre.

author: Monic Moll
title: Tiere in extremer Hitze: Statistik zeigt Tierleid auf Weiden
content:
In den Monaten Juni bis August erhalten wir von PETA Deutschland jedes Jahr viele Meldungen zu Tieren, die nicht ausreichend vor der

Hitze geschützt

 werden. Durch die langanhaltenden und ungewöhnlich hohen Temperaturen war die Anzahl der Meldungen in diesem Jahr auffällig hoch. Besonders häufig wurde uns von sogenannten Weidetieren berichtet, denen es an ausreichendem Schutz vor Hitze oder an genügend Trinkwasser fehlte. Diese Vorfälle haben wir an die zuständigen Veterinärbehörden weitergeleitet und die eingegangenen Meldungen anschließend ausgewertet.


Wie viele „Weidetiere“ betroffen waren und welche Missstände besonders häufig gemeldet wurden, erfahren Sie hier.


Insgesamt über 60 Meldungen zu „Weidetieren“ während der Hitzeperioden


So viele Meldungen vernachlässigter Tiere auf Weideflächen erreichten uns bei PETA Deutschland von Juni bis Juli 2026.


In diesem Jahr erreichten uns insgesamt 62 Meldungen zu „Weidetieren“, die unter den hohen Temperaturen litten. Darunter:


32 Meldungen zu

Schafen

/Ziegen


18 Meldungen zu Rindern


8 Meldungen zu Pferden


2 Meldungen zu Schweinen


2 Meldungen zu gefiederten Tieren


Besonders häufig fehlten den Tieren

ein baulicher Unterstand oder schattenspendende Bäume

. Zudem wurden uns Fälle gemeldet, in denen Tiere

ohne Wasser

 auskommen mussten oder ihnen nur

verschmutztes und stark erwärmtes Wasser

 zur Verfügung stand. Darüber hinaus

starben Tiere

 aufgrund der hohen Temperaturen

in Ställen

 oder

auf Transportern.


Die sich stauende Hitze sorgt dafür, dass viele Tiere noch während des Transports ins Schlachthaus sterben.


PETA meldet Vorfälle an zuständige Behörden


Wir meldeten Hinweise auf Tiere in lebensgefährlichen Situationen umgehend an die zuständigen Veterinärbehörden. Diese gingen sehr unterschiedlich mit den offensichtlichen Missständen um: Nicht von allen Veterinärbehörden erhielten wir Rückmeldungen zu den gemeldeten Fällen – immer wieder nicht einmal eine Antwort, die bestätigt, dass die Meldung bearbeitet wird.


In einigen Fällen führte auch eine wiederholte Meldung an die zuständige Behörde zu keiner sichtbaren Veränderung oder Verbesserung der Haltung. Selten wurden sofort Maßnahmen getroffen und Weidezelte aufgestellt – und selbst damit reicht der erzeugte Schatten nicht immer für alle Tiere auf der Weide aus.


Unsere Beobachtungen in diesem Bereich zeigen leider deutlich, dass auf Deutschlands Weiden größtenteils von Behördenversagen auszugehen ist. Es kann und darf nicht sein, dass das Wohlergehen der Tiere von der Sorgfältigkeit der Behörden abhängig ist.


Daher fordern wir die zuständigen Behörden dazu auf, das geltende Tierschutzrecht konsequent durchzusetzen und gemeldeten Missständen konsequent und zeitnah nachzugehen.


Bei diesen vernachlässigten Schafen auf einer Weide in Bresegard wurde offensichtlich keine Schur durchgeführt. Zudem befanden sich die verwesenden Überreste zahlreicher Tiere auf dem Grundstück.


Darum leiden Tiere bei Hitze auf der Weide


Fehlt es an ausreichendem Schutz oder einer angemessenen Versorgung und Pflege, können die hohen Temperaturen für Tiere auf der Weide zur

Belastung

 werden. Sie leiden insbesondere unter folgenden Missständen:


Keine ausreichende Wasserversorgung


„Weidetieren“ muss täglich ausreichend sauberes Wasser zur Verfügung stehen. Bei Hitze steigt der Bedarf deutlich: Schafe benötigen unter normalen Bedingungen etwa zwei bis vier Liter Wasser am Tag, bei großer Hitze und während der Aufzucht ihrer Jungtiere jedoch bis zu

zehn Liter.


[1] Bei

Kühen in der Milchindustrie

 kann der Wasserbedarf bei Hitze auf bis zu

200 Liter

 pro Tag steigen. [2]


Die Wasserbehälter müssen zudem an die Größe und Bedürfnisse der Tiere angepasst sein. [3] Leider stellen wir oft fest, dass das nicht der Fall ist. Besonders Jungtiere können aus zu tiefen

Behältern nicht trinken

. Wir empfehlen daher mehrere geeignete Trinkmöglichkeiten, die den unterschiedlichen Bedürfnissen der Herde gerecht werden. Tierhalter:innen sind zudem verpflichtet, die Herde mindestens einmal täglich zu kontrollieren. Dennoch erleben wir immer wieder, dass „Weidetiere“ tagelang

sich selbst überlassen

 werden und dann – mit viel Glück – von besorgten Passant:innen versorgt werden. Auch hier erhielten wir immer wieder die Rückmeldung, dass Augenzeug:innen die Umstände zwar bei der Polizei meldeten, jedoch nicht ernst genommen wurden.

author: hsa_oryx
title: LE SHUTTLE – TRANSPORTING CRUELTY
content:
The Hunt Saboteurs Association (HSA) has just launched a campaign to ask Le Shuttle to stop facilitating the transportation of game birds from Europe to the UK.


Le Shuttle is a significant route for bringing

live pheasants and red-legged partridges

 into Britain from European hatcheries. Around 10 million birds are imported annually, representing roughly a quarter of the birds bred for shooting.


Cacabrava rearing site based in Portugal which we previously reported as suppling the UK shooting industry


These birds will ultimately be destined for one of the shoots and game farms across the country. The vast majority of birds shot for sport in Britain are pheasants. Originally native to Asia, pheasants have been introduced to numerous countries, and are now bred on an industrial scale to supply the shooting industry.


Since 2016 estimates show that around 47 million pheasants are released in the UK annually ahead of the shooting season, alongside a further 10 million red-legged partridge. Added to birds remaining from previous releases which are estimated in the region of 3-5 million, the total population is estimated at about 50 million pheasants in the wild at the time of release.


Those numbers will decline through the seasons. Birds will die from predation, disease, environmental factors, collisions with vehicles and ultimately, shooting. Approximately a quarter of released birds will die before the shooting season even begins on the 1

st

 October.


The ecological and environmental consequences of releasing millions of non-native, intensively reared birds are considerable. Large concentrations alter the availability of food for other species, and affect local wildlife, such as reptile species which may themselves become prey for the birds.


The other way in which local wildlife is affected is through predator control. Predator numbers respond to the sudden abundance of food sources created by the annual releases. It is estimated that foxes account for a significant proportion of the birds that fail to survive until the start of the season. Predators that have benefited from the abundance of prey remain long after the birds have gone, they must then find alternative sources of food.


A larsen trap is a familiar sight on game shoots


Foxes and other perceived predators are subsequently targeted by gamekeepers, farmers, and hunts. Animals including foxes, birds of prey and corvids may be poisoned, trapped, snared, shot, while foxes are also pursued by hunts, all to deal with a ‘problem’ of their own making.


A fox about to be rescued from a snare on a Wiltshire shoot estate


The consequences of widespread use of anti-coagulant poisons go far beyond the species being targeted,

lead to secondary poisoning

 in scavenger species who include carrion in their diets such as red kites, buzzards, corvids, even invertebrate scavengers such as beetles, blowflies and ants.


A red kite was found dead in June 2025 with lethal amounts of a banned rodenticide


There is an obvious contradiction here. As the artificially inflated numbers of available prey decline through the shooting season, the predatory species that benefitted from the abundance remain, and are further regarded as problems that need to be controlled, creating a completely artificial landscape where wildlife does not stand a chance.


Anti-coagulant poison found on a shooting estate


Game shoots are not about food, this is not subsistence hunting – it is entertainment.


Historically shooting is closely associated with aristocratic and royal privilege. The transformation of the British countryside during the 18

th

 and 19

th

 centuries, including the enclosure and consolidation of common land, saw land ownership become more concentrated and helped to create the shooting-estate culture we see today.


Shooting is extremely expensive. Driven shoot days can cost hundreds or more likely – thousands of pounds depending upon the shoot and the number of birds involved, yet the end product has very little value.  Some are sold to game dealers for about 30 pence per bird, with the vast majority ending up in stink pits, or end up on bonfires, because the fact is that there is little appetite to eat the lead riddled birds.


A significant number of game birds will die before the shooting season starts


The reality is that this is an archaic and cruel pastime enjoyed by a minority, whose enjoyment is prioritised over the welfare of animals and the …

author: admin
title: ALF Liberates 7 Ducks Used as Decoys (North Italy)
content:
ENGLISH (translation): In Italy, the Senate has recently approved the reform of Law 157/1992.

Bill 1552 is now under discussion in the Chamber of Deputies. The hunting reform radically alters the historic Law 157/1992. The measure introduces the concept of ‘bioregulation’, redefining hunters as guardians of the environment and expanding the powers of the regions in wildlife management. The first dangerous change is, in fact, the alteration of the law’s title itself with the introduction of the notion of ‘management’ of wildlife, which aims to increase hunters’ involvement in local management bodies and recognises hunting as an ‘expression of a national tradition’ but also as a ‘sporting and physical activity’ and as a means of controlling invasive species. The overwhelming majority of Italians are opposed to this bloody and predatory activity, yet the Italian government has nevertheless decided to favour that 1 per cent of the population who take pleasure in abusing and plundering the woods for their own sadistic amusement: the hunters. Our response will always be one of animal liberation, because killing, abusing or keeping captive living beings who, like us, have a right to life is, in our view, unjust: we have therefore decided to go to one of the many fixed hunting posts used by hunters to free seven ducks who were shamefully kept in cages, awaiting use as live decoys – that is, as bait for other ducks that would then be killed by the cowardly hunter.

Instead of moving towards the abolition of hunting, Italy has chosen to increase the killing of animals, to expand the list of huntable species (including, if necessary for population control, even the wolf) and to allow hunters to manage all this, turning our lands into battlefields where the most dangerous predator always wins: the human being.

We say, and will always say, NO to the killing of any animal. Lex injusta non est lex.

THE A.L.F. IS WATCHING AND THERE IS NO PLACE TO HIDE.

ITALIAN (original): In Italia in questi giorni e’ stata approvata dal Senato la riforma della Legge 157/1992.

Il DDL 1552 è ora in discussione alla Camera dei Deputati. La riforma della caccia modifica radicalmente la storica Legge 157/1992. Il provvedimento introduce il concetto di “bioregolazione”, ridefinendo i cacciatori come tutori dell’ambiente e ampliando le competenze delle Regioni nella gestione faunistica. La prima pericolosa novità infatti è il cambiamento del titolo della legge stessa con l’introduzione della nozione di «gestione» della fauna, che punta ad un maggiore coinvolgimento dei cacciatori negli organi territoriali di gestione e che riconosce la caccia come «espressione di una tradizione nazionale» ma anche come «attività sportiva e motoria» e come azione per il contenimento delle specie invasive. La stragrande maggioranza degli italiani è contro questa attività sanguinaria e predatoria, ma il governo italiano ha deciso ugualmente di favorire quell’ 1% di popolazione che si diverte ad abusare e saccheggiare i boschi per il proprio sadico divertimento: i cacciatori. La nostra risposta sarà sempre quella della liberazione animale perché uccidere, abusare, detenere essere viventi che hanno diritto come noi a vivere è per noi ingiusto: abbiamo deciso quindi di andare presso uno dei tanti appostamenti fissi utilizzati dai cacciatori per liberare n° 7 anatre vergognosamente detenute in gabbia in attesa di essere utilizzate come richiami vivi cioè come esche per altre anatre che sarebbero poi state uccise dal vigliacco cacciatore.

Invece di andare verso l’abolizione della caccia, l’Italia ha scelto di incrementare le uccisioni di animali, di aumentare le specie cacciabili (tra cui,se necessario per il contenimento, anche il lupo) e di permettere ai cacciatori di gestire tutto questo trasformando in campi di battaglia i nostri territori dove vince sempre il predatore più pericoloso: l’essere umano.

Noi diciamo e diremo sempre NO all’ uccisione di ogni animale. Lex injusta non est lex.

THE A.L.F. IS WATCHING AND THERE IS NOT PLACE TO HIDE.

author: PETA-Team
title: Drohnenangriff in der Ukraine: Helfer von PETA-Partnerorganisation bei Tierrettung verletzt
content:
Symbolbild.


Bei einem

Rettungseinsatz in der Ukraine

 ist am Nachmittag des 31. August 2026 ein Fahrzeug der PETA-Partnerorganisation

Animal Rescue Kharkiv (ARK)

 von einer Drohne angegriffen worden. Dabei wurden zwei Tierschützer verletzt. Zum Zeitpunkt des Angriffs befanden sich außerdem

gerettete Tiere

 im Fahrzeug.


Das Team war in einem vom Krieg betroffenen Gebiet unterwegs, um Tiere in Sicherheit zu bringen.


Drohnenangriff auf Tierrettungsteam: Zwei Helfer wurden verletzt


Bei dem Angriff wurden ein Helfer von

Animal Rescue Kharkiv

 (ARK) sowie ein Tierschützer der französischen Organisation

Crisis France

 verletzt. Letzterer erlitt zahlreiche Verletzungen durch Splitter und musste operiert werden.


Auch der ARK-Helfer wurde durch den Angriff verletzt. Zunächst bestand unter anderem Sorge wegen einer Verletzung am Auge. Nach jüngsten Informationen von

Animal Rescue Kharkiv

 sind seine Augen glücklicherweise in Ordnung, die Wunde am Arm wurde genäht.


Der Helfer von

Crisis France

 hat die Operation überstanden.

Nach aktuellem Kenntnisstand besteht bei beiden Tierrettern keine Lebensgefahr.

 Nun stehen ihre weitere medizinische Versorgung und Genesung im Vordergrund.


Das Team von

Animal Rescue Kharkiv

 organisierte nach dem Angriff gemeinsam mit weiteren Helfer:innen die Versorgung und den Transport der Verletzten.


Gerettete Tiere nach Drohnenangriff in Sicherheit gebracht


Die geretteten Tiere befanden sich während des Angriffs noch im Fahrzeug. Ein weiterer Helfer machte sich anschließend auf den Weg, um sie zu übernehmen. Mittlerweile wurden die traumatisierten Tiere an einen sicheren Ort gebracht.


Der Vorfall zeigt erneut, welchen

lebensgefährlichen Bedingungen

 die Tierschützer:innen in der Ukraine bei ihren Einsätzen ausgesetzt sind. Trotz der anhaltenden Gefahren begeben sich die Teams weiterhin in betroffene Gebiete, evakuieren zurückgelassene Tiere und bringen sie an sichere Orte.


Das ARK-Team rettet Tiere in den Kriegsgebieten der Ukraine, oft unter großer Gefahr. Symbolbild.


PETA und Animal Rescue Kharkiv retten weiterhin Tiere in der Ukraine


Seit Beginn des Krieges arbeiten wir von PETA Deutschland mit

Animal Rescue Kharkiv

 und weiteren Partnern zusammen, um möglichst viele Tiere zu retten. Die Helfenden versorgen Tiere mit

Nahrung und medizinischer Hilfe

, evakuieren sie aus gefährlichen Gebieten und

bringen sie in Sicherheit

.


Der aktuelle Angriff macht auf erschütternde Weise deutlich, dass die Rettungseinsätze nicht nur für die Tiere, sondern auch für die Menschen, die ihnen helfen, mit erheblichen Gefahren verbunden sind.


Unterstützen Sie unseren Einsatz in der Ukraine: Helfen Sie jetzt mit Ihrer Spende und retten Sie Tierleben


Die Lage in den ukrainischen Kriegsgebieten bleibt angespannt und lebensgefährlich – für alle Lebewesen. Wir werden gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern vor Ort weiterhin alles in unserer Macht Stehende tun, um den Tieren in der Ukraine zu helfen und ihnen eine bessere Zukunft zu ermöglichen. Sie können uns dabei mit Ihrer Spende an den Global Compassion Fund zielgerichtet unterstützen.


Jetzt PETAs Ukraine-Einsatz unterstützen


The post

Drohnenangriff in der Ukraine: Helfer von PETA-Partnerorganisation bei Tierrettung verletzt

 appeared first on

PETA Deutschland e.V.

.

author: winter oak
title: A youthful cry of revolt
content:
by Paul Cudenec, who reads the article

here


I was rummaging around the other day and came across a folder of articles that I had been lining up in 1985, when I was 22 years old, for a zine called

New Renaissance

 that a friend and I were planning to, but never did, launch.


I was quite surprised to find how much of it aligned with what I say today, with the only main difference being that at the time I regarded the globalist modernisation of British society as being simply “Americanisation”.


My consistency is reassuring, I suppose, although I am left with the nagging worry that I have been repeating myself for more than 40 years now!


I warned that we were living in “a system based on the right to be greedy. A system controlled and defended by those with only their own material interests at heart”.


Then, as now, I was calling for “New Life” – a way of thinking completely free of all the usual political ideologies and the assumptions that come with them.


I asked in ‘Facing the Issue’: “Why can we not hear men or women with something of some significance to say to the world? Where are the voices of the prophets, the men of vision? Where are the great minds, the long-term minds, the minds that see through trivia as a hot blade cuts through ice?…


“They are, I fear, outcasts of our society every one of them. Lunatics, fruitcakes on the fringes of modern ‘life’, they are not to be exposed to the public”.


In a piece called ‘The State of Democracy’ I wrote: “It is characteristic of Democratic states that they claim to represent the interests of their population without ever directly consulting this population as to what exactly these interests might be.


“In this respect a Democracy does not differ from a totalitarian state. The Soviet state claims to rule in the interests of socialism, Hitler’s state claimed to rule in the interests of the German race, the British state claims to represent the interests of Democracy and the British public.


“It doesn’t really matter to the state what it says it is acting in the interests of. It has control and there’s no way anyone else is going to have a say…


“Are all the political parties that fight for the votes of the gullible public and thus maintain the illusion of democratic decision-making merely opposing factions in an all-powerful state system as impenetrable as that of the Soviet Union or the Third Reich?”


Quite right, young Paul, although you should have placed the word “opposing” in inverted commas!


In ‘Mass Funeral’ I summed up the

New Renaissance

 outlook thusly: “In Mass Society we are battery hens. Opposition to capitalism is not opposition to Mass Society. Communism and Fascism only bolstered its domination.


“We call for total rejection of Mass Society. We must strive for the antithesis of all that it holds sacred. We place quality infinitely higher than quantity”.


I still like this short piece entitled ‘The Modern Slave’.


They keep me well so I will not complain.


Without them I would have no home.


My wife depends on the security they offer.


It is their gifts that feed my children.


They grant me days in the year for myself and they give me entertainment to pass the time.


It is thanks to them that I have met my friends. We work together and are glad of our good fortune.


Others have no work at all. We all know that work makes us free.


We may act as we please, so long as we abide by their rules.


I may think as I will, so long as I think no ill of them.


When I was young, I dreamed of flight. I was foolish. There is nowhere to flee to. Without them I would die.


I give them nothing but my body, my soul and my time.


I am not a slave for I see no chains.


And I particularly enjoyed the youthful energy inveighing against “A Flaccid Reign”, an article which for some reason I was planning to publish under the pseudonym “Jean-Paul Béarn”.


“Jean-Paul” wrote:


In the christian bible, Jesus asserted that the meek would inherit the earth.


Unfortunately, they did.


Passivity is the modern malaise that is in danger of rendering impotent the whole of mankind.


A mentality has emerged in the 1980s – automised, sanitised times – that negates the fundamental essence of the human spirit. A mentality that worships inertia, inaction, passivity. A mentality that allows people to lead an existence composed entirely of second-hand experiences.


Imagine the archetypal modern man.


He poses at the wheel of his air-conditioned car, or …

title: Isparta’da orman alanında kurulacak barit ocağı ÇED onayı
content:
Fotoğraf: Proje Tanıtım Dosyası

Eylem Nazlıer [email protected]

Isparta – Isparta’nın Şarkikaraağaç ilçesi Çarıksaraylar köyü mevkiinde Ferbil Madencilik Yenilenebilir Enerji Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Şirketi tarafından işletilmesi planlanan IV. Grup barit ocağı projesi için “ÇED Gerekli Değildir” kararı verildi.

385,19 hektarlık maden ruhsat sahasının 24,96 hektarlık bölümünde kurulması planlanan ocakta yılda 75 bin ton barit ve 300 bin ton pasa olmak üzere toplam 375 bin ton üretim yapılması öngörülüyor.

ÇED dosyasındaki arazi kullanım bilgilerine göre projenin kullanılacağı 24,96 hektarlık alanın tamamı orman alanı içerisinde kalıyor. Öte yandan Isparta Valiliği Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği İl Müdürlüğünün kurum görüşünde, proje alanının Antalya-Burdur-Isparta Planlama Bölgesi 1/100.000 ölçekli Çevre Düzeni Planı’nda hem “Tarım Arazisi” hem de “Orman Alanı” gösterimleri içerisinde kaldığı ve alanın içinden “Akarsu” ile “Köy Yolu” geçtiği tespit edildi.

Proje alanına en yakın yerleşim yeri, güneyde bulunan Çarıksaraylar köyündeki konutlar. Konutların proje alanına kuş uçuşu yaklaşık 2 bin 900 metre mesafede olduğu belirtiliyor. En yakın cami 3 bin 965 metre, mezarlık 3 bin 795 metre, okul 4 bin 80 metre, Şarkikaraağaç Devlet Hastanesi ise 9 bin 200 metre uzaklıkta.

Proje alanı, Beyşehir Gölü Havzası Özel Hükümleri kapsamında uzak mesafeli koruma alanında bulunuyor. Konya Su ve Kanalizasyon İdaresinin görüşünde proje alanı ve yakın çevresinde kayıtlı içme suyu ve kanalizasyon tesisi bulunmadığı, ancak sahanın Beyşehir Gölü Havzası Özel Hükümleri uyarınca uzak mesafeli koruma alanında kalıyor.

Proje alanına en yakın akar dere ise alanın 205 metre batısından geçen Derbent Deresi. Arpayeri Deresi ise alanın 990 metre doğusunda bulunuyor.

Dosyadaki fauna ve flora değerlendirmesine göre proje alanı milli park, tabiat parkı, tabiatı koruma alanı, yaban hayatı geliştirme sahası veya sit alanı içerisinde bulunmuyor. Ancak alanın Çarıksaraylar Devlet Avlağı içerisinde olduğu ve bu nedenle av ve yaban hayatı mevzuatı bakımından önem taşıdığı belirtiliyor.

Proje alanında IUCN kapsamında “Hassas” kategoride bulunan yaygın tosbağa (Testudo graeca) tespit edilmiş. Raporda bu türün düşük hareket yeteneği nedeniyle arazi hazırlığı ve bitkisel toprak sıyırma çalışmalarından doğrudan etkilenme riski bulunduğu belirtiliyor.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Mavic Conde
title: Surigao town’s barangays unite behind anti-mining resolution
content:
CARMEN, Surigao del Sur – One mining exploration has brought all eight barangays of this town together in opposition, with local councils warning that disturbance in one part of its subwatersheds could cascade the effect on water sources, farming, and other local livelihoods.

Barangays Antao, Cancavan, Esperanza, Hinapoyan, Puyat, San Vicente, Santa Cruz, and Poblacion Carmen each passed resolutions expressing “strong opposition” to the application of Amalgamated Iron Works, Inc. (AIWI) to explore for nickel deposits.

The resolutions, adopted in July, backed the municipal government’s July 28 resolution rejecting the application. The town also issued a manifesto during a public hearing attended by residents, advocates, and government officials, declaring: “Do not destroy the resource base that has sustained us through the years. No to mining in Carmen.”

The proposed exploration lies within the Suwahid-Daan subwatershed in Barangay Hinapoyan, one of the several interconnected water systems protected under Carmen’s 2025 ordinance, which the Provincial Government adopted the same year.

The ordinance identifies Suwahid-Daan as feeding irrigation in Esperanza and San Vicente, Hubason as supplying multiple barangays and supporting eco-tourism, Agasan-Cadilotan flowing into the Tago River system, and Bayoyo-Panaghuyan as supplying drinking water and irrigation extending to another town.

The Buayan sub-watershed in Barangay San Vicente has an added layer of protection as part of the Carac-an Watershed Forest Reserve under Presidential Proclamation 1747.

All councils cited the constitutional right to a balanced ecology and consultation requirements under the Local Government Code in opposing the application.

These water systems support Carmen’s main livelihoods, including crop (coconut, corn, and rice) farming, livestock, and poultry raising.

Farmer Josefina Mainit, 54, said agriculture is already becoming harder to sustain. Both of her rice crops failed last year because of erratic weather, while low buying prices further squeezed their income.

“We don’t want mining here because it will affect farmers. We will lose our source of livelihood, and it will be hard for us to survive,” said Mainit, a mother of five.

The Mainit couple tills two hectares of irrigated land in Purok 5 as tenants and has returned to poultry raising to augment their income. Mainit previously served as a barangay secretary, while her husband worked as a mining driver. He did not seek another job at any mining site after their contract ended because of illness and concerns of dust exposure.

Carmen’s resistance to mining is not new. In 2020, the Sangguniang Bayan issued a moratorium on mining but failed to secure provincial support. It has also continued to oppose attempts to operate illegal small-scale mining operations on its land.

The eight barangay resolutions add their support to water-protection advocates in neighboring Cantilan town who are using the same legal protection to stop mining in the province’s vital water systems. (RVO)

author: daniel
title: Sounds for Climate
content:
Hier gilt zugleich: „Wenn ich nicht revoltieren kann, ist es nicht mein Tanz!“ Sounds for Climate ist ein rebellisches Festival, das zugleich Lösungen für die Probleme zeigt, die uns der Kapitalismus eingebrockt hat. Das genannte Lineup gehört dazu, es ist in diesem Jahr wieder hochpolitisch. Hinzu kommen Redebeiträge, Infostände, Kunstausstellungen und Workshops, die zeigen, dass ein besseres Leben möglich ist. Das ganze Festival ist auf Nachhaltigkeit ausgelegt und wird diesmal völlig klimaneutral sein: Der Strom kommt aus großen Solarbatterien und Photovoltaik-Modulen! Feines veganes Catering, Mehrweggeschirr, regionale Bio-Getränke, Kompost-Klos usw. Sounds for Climate ist aus den Kämpfen zur Rettung des Hambacher Waldes entstanden und fand 2019 zum ersten Mal statt. Die Klimakatastrophe steht thematisch im Mittelpunkt. 2026 wird auch das gesellschaftliche Klima angesprochen. Denn das Vordringen rechtsextremer Kräfte ins Zentrum der Politik ist heute eine massive Bedrohung des guten Lebens und der widerständigen Kultur – und führt schon jetzt dazu, dass alle zaghaften Ansätze einer Klimaschutzpolitik von den bürgerlichen Parteien wieder zerstört werden. author: The Canadian Press
title: Changes to Canada’s climate now ‘irreversible,’ federal report says
content:
The impacts of climate change in Canada are now largely irreversible and average temperatures are expected to rise by at least 3.5 C by the end of the century, a new government report warns.


The report, published Thursday, is the second released by

Environment and Climate Change Canada

 examining changes to Canada’s climate. It was authored by nearly two dozen government and climate science experts.


It says even if the world reaches net-zero emissions by 2075 — which means any greenhouse gases still emitted are captured by nature or technology — the effects in Canada will be stark. They include a nearly a 50 per cent increase in the area burned by wildfires, and an forecast that glaciers in Western Canada will lose more than 75 per cent of their mass.


“The most surprising thing is the contrast between what the report says that we can expect for our future climate, and the level of action that the federal government and other governments in Canada are taking,” said Ryan Ness, adaptation research director at the Canadian Climate Institute.


With the current climate policies in place around the world, average temperatures in Canada are expected to rise five degrees by the year 2100, with a 50 per cent chance that winter temperatures will increase by more than 10 C in much of Nunavut.


“That’s a lot of climate change that we have to adapt to and we’re not ready for it,” Ness said, adding Canada is falling behind on climate adaptation.


“We’re already seeing how vulnerable we are to the climate-driven disasters that we’ve experienced over the last few years. It’s only going to get worse, and yet the pace of action on adaptation is not high.”


Ness said adaptation should include things like retrofitting homes with more fireproof material and building firebreaks and flood walls around communities.


In a report issued last year on Canada’s national climate adaptation strategy, Canadian environment commissioner Jerry DeMarco said Ottawa’s efforts to prepare the country for the impacts of climate change had stumbled out of the gate.


DeMarco’s report concluded the strategy was not effectively designed, did not prioritize Canada’s climate change risks, and that departments relied instead on existing priorities and consultations.


DeMarco cited the short-term health impacts of wildfire smoke, estimated to cost between $410 million and $1.8 billion annually between 2013 and 2018. He also remarked on the spike in Lyme disease cases from 144 in 2009 to 2,525 in 2022 — an increase of more than 1,500 per cent.


A progress report on the climate adaptation strategy released by Ottawa last month said there are hundreds of new flood-mapping projects underway to better identify flood-prone areas. It also acknowledged that 94 per cent of people living in high-risk areas don’t yet know their home is susceptible to floods.


The new report released Thursday also said droughts and flash floods will become more frequent and severe as temperatures rise.


“Canada’s latest state of the climate report is a stark warning of what Canadians will face if governments fail to tackle the climate crisis with the urgency it requires,” said Julia Levin, associate director of national climate at Environmental Defence.


“This report should be a call to action. What the future looks like for our children depends on the policy choices being made today. The worst impacts of climate change are far from inevitable.”


Read More: 


Global warming will exceed limit, UN says in a report that maps path to get back below danger zone 


In response to the report, the office of Environment Minister Julie Dabrusin said the government is still committed to reaching net-zero by 2050.


“To protect Canadians from the impacts of climate change and severe weather, the federal government has committed more than $2.1 billion to implement the National Adaptation Strategy and support a wide range of adaptation-related activities,” said Chris Zhou, Dabrusin’s director of communications.


“Our government is moving with urgency to fight climate change, while working together to build the energy security, industrial capacity, and strategic autonomy that will define this century for Canada.”


Story by Nick Murray

Changes to Canada’s climate now ‘irreversible,’ federal report says

APTN News

author: Sasha Abramsky
title: Wildfires Are Sweeping North America. Trump Fired the People Who Fight Them.
content:
As climate change worsens wildfires, a gutted US Forest Service is struggling to keep up.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

The 2026 fire season has been devastating for the U.S. On September 1, the National Interagency Fire Center released data showing that, year-to-date, more than 52,000 wildfires had, cumulatively, burned 8.2 million acres of land in the U.S. That’s 126 percent of the 10-year rolling average for the number of annual fires, and 163 percent of the average acreage burned each year.In Oregon alone, well over 2 million acres have turned to ash.

This is what happens when a government no longer works to reduce climate change and its consequences, and at the same time no longer invests adequately in the workers and agencies that have the skills to corral the increasingly frequent fires breaking out in parched, drought-stricken regions.

As DOGE’s assault on the U.S. government picked up steam last year, the U.S. Forest Service (USFS) ended up in the crosshairs. By year’s end, more than 6,000 employees, many of them highly skilled firefighters and fire prevention specialists, had been severed from federal employment. Astoundingly, the National Federation of Federal Employees (NFFE) estimated that 57 out of 77 research labs, whose employees were doing vital work both preparing for fires and responding once they broke out, were shuttered.

Year-to-date, more than 52,000 wildfires had burned 8.2 million acres of land in the U.S.

The Trump administration claims it is simply streamlining resources and getting rid of redundancies. It has consolidated four separate federal fire-fighting systems into a new agency, the U.S. Wildland Fire Service; but, in doing so, it has ended up with fewer personnel and resources. The U.S. Forest Service, which previously provided the core of the federal firefighting system, has lost 16 percent of its workforce since Trump’s inauguration in January 2025 and has drastically reduced, by 35 percent, the acreage in the American west that it is managing through prescribed burns and other treatments to reduce the likelihood of fires breaking out.

In an effort that critics argue deliberately dilutes the power of the Forest Service in favor of the logging industry, the administration has decided to relocate the USFS headquarters from D.C. to Salt Lake City — all but guaranteeing that many top officials, unwilling to uproot their lives and move 2,000 miles across country, will leave the agency. It has also decided to shutter nine regional USFS offices, leaving a dearth of expertise on the ground in communities that need it most.

The U.S. Forest Service has lost 16 percent of its workforce since Trump’s inauguration in January 2025.

In reporting last year for my book on the DOGE cuts, American Carnage: How Trump, Musk, and DOGE Butchered the US Government, I interviewed a recently fired Fire Service employee, whose work had involved coordinating with ranchers in Kansas and Colorado to implement fire-prevention strategies in an increasingly arid American West, who despaired at the logic of such mass firings on the cusp of fire season. He and his colleagues saw an experiment in government dysfunction unfolding; screw around with major government systems, find out the consequences. Their commonsense conclusion: if there are far fewer fire specialists and firefighters on hand, more fires will break out, and the damage those fires do will be greater.

On the ground, the United States is now seeing the impact of a gutted fire response system. During the recent destructive Hawk Fire near Reno, Nevada, this August, the neighboring state of California’s Office of Emergency Services mobilized personnel and resources from 28 local government fire agencies to provide assistance; Australia and New Zealand also provided hundreds of firefighting personnel to fight the Hawk Fire and others in the region. Meanwhile, at the federal level, while FEMA did authorize funds to fight the fire, U.S. Forest Service firefighters have reported extraordinary shortages of staff, with many firefighters this year having to put in 1,000 hours of overtime to try to plug gaps when major fires break out. Put simply, the federal government is letting down millions of Americans on the front lines of climate change whose properties, and lives, are increasingly at risk as megafires become the new norm.

title: El Niño despertó: lluvias extremas y olas de calor para un planeta en crisis climática
content:
Por Silvia Oliviero Ghietto*


La Organización Meteorológica Mundial (OMM) emitió un comunicado en el que advirtió que el fenómeno climático El Niño, que ya está en marcha, puede alcanzar una intensidad mayor que la habitual. En Argentina, a partir de noviembre-diciembre, aumenta la posibilidad de que ocurran

eventos de precipitaciones extremas en la Cuenca del Plata

 (integrada por Corrientes, Misiones, Formosa, Santa Fe, Entre Ríos, Buenos Aires, Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires y Chaco)

y en el Noroeste de la Patagonia

.


El Niño continúa intensificándose de forma constante combinado con océanos globales excepcionalmente cálidos y la probabilidad de un dipolo positivo en el Océano Índico, lo que determina una

probabilidad

de casi el 100 por ciento

 de un evento “muy fuerte”

. Por lo tanto, se espera que domine los patrones climáticos globales durante la temporada 2026-2027, con

aumento de probabilidad de temperaturas superiores a lo normal

 en gran parte del mundo y con cambios significativos en los patrones de lluvia, segúnel

C

entro de Predicción Climática de la Administración Nacional Oceánica y Atmosférica de Estados Unidos.


Las proyecciones científicas actuales sugieren que este El Niño podría convertirse en un evento comparable con algunos de los episodios más impactantes de las últimas décadas superando incluso el ocurrido en 1998. Los eventos de El Niño suelen alcanzar su punto máximo hacia finales del año, con la máxima influencia que suele sentirse entre noviembre y febrero.


Vale la pena aclarar que la Organización Meteorológica Mundial y las Instituciones de Referencia Climática clasifican los eventos de la Oscilación El Niño-Sur (ENSO) como débiles, moderados, fuertes o muy fuertes. Por lo tanto, el término "súper El Niño" utilizado por los medios de comunicación no forma parte del sistema de clasificación operativo y oficial.


Infografía: Organización Meteorológica Mundial


¿Que sabemos del fenómeno del Niño?


El Niño y La Niña son fases opuestas de

un patrón climático natural

 conocido como la Oscilación El Niño-Sur (ENSO), que

implica fluctuaciones de las temperaturas oceánicas en el Pacífico ecuatorial central y oriental, junto con cambios en la atmósfera

 suprayacente. Cuando la “Circulación Walker” (un flujo masivo de aire de este a oeste impulsado por las diferencias de temperatura y presión entre los océanos cálido occidental y el frío del este) se modifica desplazándose hacia el este en dirección a Sudamérica y la temperatura oceánica supera los 0,5 °C, se declara El Niño.


La transición entre estas fases extremas suele ocurrir cada dos a siete años. Tanto El Niño como La Niña generalmente comienzan a desarrollarse entre marzo y junio y alcanzan su máxima intensidad entre noviembre y febrero.


El Niño se caracteriza por temperaturas superficiales oceánicas inusualmente cálidas en el Pacífico

 central y oriental.

El nombre proviene de pescadores y marineros peruanos que notaron una corriente cálida

, asociada a la reducción de capturas de pescado, y la llamaron El Niño (probablemente porque se hacía visible en torno a Navidad).


El Niño se predice mediante el monitoreo de las condiciones en el océano Pacífico tropical. A través de modelos climáticos, la comunidad científica puede estimar cómo puede evolucionar en los próximos meses y

predecir patrones climáticos con seis meses de anticipación

. Se basa en una red global de observaciones, incluidos satélites, buques de océano, barcos de investigación y medidas atmosféricas operadas por los Servicios Meteorológicos y Hidrológicos Nacionales y Organizaciones Internacionales.


Desde la década de 1980, el enfoque dominante para medir o identificar El Niño ha sido el uso del Índice Oceánico Niño (ONI), que calcula a lo largo de un promedio de tres meses la Anomalía de Temperatura Superficial del Mar en una región específica del Pacífico llamada región Niño. En los últimos años y con la presencia del calentamiento global, una métrica más reciente llamada Índice Relativo Oceánico Niño (RONI) ha ganado terreno. Este enfoque mide el calentamiento relativo, no solo el absoluto, ayudando a la comunidad científica a evaluar si un evento de calentamiento está impulsado por el ENSO o se debe principalmente al calentamiento global oceánico.

title: 9,000-year-old mining workshop unearthed in Ergani
content:
Excavations carried out at Kotaberçem (Çayönü Mound) in the Ergani district of Amed (Diyarbakır) have uncovered a mining workshop of approximately 5 square meters, dating to 6900–6800 BCE. Raw and processed pieces of malachite, as well as copper objects, were found at the site. The excavations, wrote Mezopotamya Agency (MA), were led by Çanakkale Onsekiz Mart University, and identified at least six postholes around the workshop, which was uncovered in the western part of the settlement, as well as a stone-paved work area at its center.


The postholes possibly indicate that the production area may have been covered with a canopy or shelter. Raw and semi-processed malachite, processed malachite samples, copper beads, and various copper objects were found in the workshop. Including finds from the center of the workshop and its immediate surroundings, the number of malachite and copper fragments identified across the wider excavation area has reportedly reached approximately 42.


Shedding light on the history of mining


The discovery of raw materials, semi-processed pieces, and finished products in the same area indicates that mining activities were carried out in an organized manner within a designated work area. Earlier evidence of the use of copper and malachite at Kotaberçem dates back as far as 9100 BCE. The new discovery is said to demonstrate that the region’s mining tradition developed and continued for approximately 2,000 years.


Located within the Ergani and Tigris River Basin, Kotaberçem is among the important settlements of the Neolithic period, with finds providing evidence of the development of settled life, agriculture, and animal husbandry.

title: Nachhaltigkeit oder Müllproblem? Billig-Kleidung/Fast Fashion – was Mode zum Klimafaktor Nummer 1 macht

Dossier

Video und Beitrag von Anke Heinhaus vom 12.03.2020 beim Hessischen Rundfunk

„

Zwölf Euro Abgabe pro Jacke, neun Euro für eine Jeans, zwei Euro für ein T-Shirt: Frankreich will die Verbreitung von Billigmode mit Strafzahlungen einschränken. In den kommenden Jahren sollen sie noch weiter angehoben werden.


Eine Billigjacke eines Onlinehändlers wie Shein oder Temu kostet in Frankreich künftig bis zu zwölf Euro mehr. Die Regierung veröffentlichte am Freitag im Amtsblatt die neuen Regeln, die die Verbreitung sogenannter Wegwerfmode einschränken sollen und ab dem 1. September gelten. Im laufenden Jahr werden demnach auch 50 Cent für Unterhosen oder Socken, zwei Euro für ein T-Shirt und neun Euro für Jeans fällig, die bestimmten Kriterien entsprechen. Frankreich wolle auf diese Weise gegen ein Geschäftsmodell vorgehen, »das darauf beruht, dass ein Kleidungsstück in Rekordzeit von der Ladenfläche in die Mülltonne wandert«, schrieb der Umweltstaatssekretär Mathieu Lefèvre im Onlinedienst X.


»Die schädlichen Auswirkungen der Ultra-Fast-Fashion auf unsere Umwelt und unsere Wirtschaft sind bekannt und dokumentiert«, fügte er hinzu. Entscheidend ist die Menge der Modelle, die auf den Markt gebracht werden, und deren Preis im Verhältnis zu einer Reparatur.


Anstieg programmiert


Die Strafzahlungen sollen bis 2030 ansteigen und dann etwa zwei Euro für Unterhosen und 19,50 Euro für eine Jacke erreichen. Das Geld soll in einen Fonds fließen, mit dem vorbildliche Unternehmen unterstützt werden sollen. Dazu sind bislang keine Details bekannt

Et, par cette étreinte, tenter de leur faire savoir combien nous les admirons, les respectons et les aimons. [Les proches de disparu·es au Mexique s’organisent au sein de collectifs et de brigades. Le nom de Buscadoras ou Buscadores fait référence aux « chercheur·ses » de ces diparus, ndt] Afin de pouvoir nous réunir avec tous les groupes qui recherchent leurs absent.es, sans distinction de géographie, de calendrier, de couleur, de race, de langue, de religion, d’histoire et d’appartenance politique, et qui le souhaitent, nous avons demandé au Centre des Droits Humains Fray Bartolomé de Las Casas ([CDH-Frayba]) qu’il nous aide à préparer et à organiser ces rencontres, avec le soutien du Réseau Todos los Derechos para Todos y Todas [Tous les droits pour tous et toutes], du Pro [CDH-Miguel Agustín Pro], et des diverses organisations non-gouvernementales de défense des droits humains. Le Frayba a répondu favorablement à notre demande et a créé un courrier électronique spécial pour que les groupes, collectifs et collectives, mouvements et organisations du Mexique et d’Amérique Centrale engagés dans la recherche de la vérité et de la justice pour leurs absent.es, proposent des dates de rencontre avec nous à Mexico en décembre 2026. Nous leur demandons aussi d’indiquer s’ils ont besoin d’aide pour leur hébergement et leur alimentation durant leur séjour à Mexico. Nous sommes convaincus que des personnes individuelles, des groupes, des collectifs et collectives, des mouvements et des organisations de la Sexta et des signataires de la Déclaration pour la Vie feront preuve de générosité. Toutefois, si ce n’est pas le cas, la délégation zapatiste du Voyage pour la Vie – Chapitre Mexique est disposée à partager toit et nourriture avec vous. Elle est même prête à réduire le contingent zapatiste afin que personne ne se retrouve sans hébergement temporaire. Les coordonnées que le Frayba nous a communiquées sont les suivantes : Courriel : dondeestan@frayba.org.mx Il met également à disposition les numéros de portable suivants : Dora Roblero García : 967-134-07-59 Pedro Faro Navarro : 967-102-06-40 Le Frayba nous informe que chaque groupe qui les contactera recevra une sorte de formulaire à remplir avec ses coordonnées ; elles permettront de synthétiser les informations nécessaires à l’organisation des rencontres.

2.- Un autre objectif est de nous réunir avec les groupes, collectifs, mouvements et organisations de la Sexta de Mexico et de ses alentours. Et ceci, afin de convenir ensemble des activités et de voir les possibilités d’une seconde étape de ce chapitre du Voyage pour la Vie. Nous pensons que, durant notre séjour à Mexico, nous pourrions entreprendre des actions pour relancer la Sexta sur le territoire qu’ils appellent « Mexique ». author: Reynard Magtoto
title: Bicol human rights lawyer, transport leader get death threats
content:
AES Watch volunteers plot on Phl map reported poll troubles from May 2 to May 17

LEGAZPI CITY, Albay – “Malapit ka na.” (Your end is near.)

This was the message received by two activists in the Bicol region.

Bartolome “Bart” Rayco on August 28. In the morning of that day, he found this note along with two bullets bound with a black ribbon at the entrance of their family’s small carinderia in Legazpi City.

Rayco is the vice president and Legal Aid Chairperson of the Integrated Bar of the Philippines (IBP) Albay Chapter. He is also a member of the National Union of People’s Lawyers (NUPL) and former vice-chairperson for Luzon.

The following day, August 29, transport leader Ramon Rescovilla also found a bullet tied with a black ribbon in the passenger seat of a parked blue truck in front of his house in Daraga, with a note “Ramon Riscovilla, MALAPIT KA NA!”. He is the chairperson of the Bicol-wide transport group Concerned Operators and Drivers for Reforms (CONDOR) and national vice-chairperson of transport group Piston.

According to human rights group Karapatan, the threats are “desperate acts of those who only know killing” and appear to have been carried out and written by the same person, using the same pen.

“The purpose and message of the warning is also clear, particularly to the organizations they belong to and to Bicolanos in general, that Marcos administration is ready to suppress free organizing, legitimate criticism, and just resistance,” Karapatan Bicol stated.

Rayco and Rescovilla are prominent activists in the region denouncing graft and corruption under the Marcos administration.

“This cowardly act of intimidation is not merely an attack on one individual but a direct assault on the collective struggle for transparency, accountability, and justice in Albay and the entire Bicol Region,” Albay Movement Against Corruption (AMAC) stated.

“The only investment of the people to expose the rotten state is their voice. It is never a crime to oppose the corruption in flood control, the relentless increase in the prices of gasoline and basic commodities, the very low wages of workers in Bicol, and the lack of farmlands for the farmers,” Karapatan Bicol said.

They added, “The real criminals are those who loot the public treasury, protect foreign mines, and continue to destroy the livelihood and hope of the Filipino people to change our miserable situation.”

Despite having received death threats, Rayco and Rescovilla have continued with their work as leaders in the region.

“Obviously, this is work-related harassment. Although, of course we will not be deterred. We will not stop working for justice,” Rayco said.

Prior to the incident, Rescovilla told Bulatlat that he was visited four times last year by the elements of the Civil Military 93rd Civil Military Operations (CMO) Company of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP). He was reportedly offered a monthly salary of P20,000 ($320.32) in exchange for stopping his involvement as a transport leader.

Rescovilla was arrested in September 2020 and spent four years behind bars on trumped-up charges of murder and illegal possession of firearms and explosives. He had posted bail for the murder charge as early as 2023. In December 2025, he walked free when the illegal possession case was dismissed. Rayco had served as Rescovilla’s counsel in the latter case.

“In a democratic society, bullets, threats, surveillance, intimidation, or violence should not be used to respond to the grievances of the people. The use of this type of intimidation is not only a threat against an individual. It is also a threat to the freedom of all workers to organize, express themselves, stand up, and fight for their rights,” Condor Piston Bicol stated.

Karapatan called on the Commission on Human Rights (CHR) to immediately investigate the threats against Rayco and Rescovilla, identify the perpetrators, and take steps to ensure their safety.

“A human rights lawyer who represented a targeted transport leader is now being threatened in the same manner as his former client. We should not allow Atty. Rayco and Rescovilla to be put in harm’s way. We have seen far too many instances where threats were followed by actual killings,” Karapatan secretary general Cristina Palabay said.

In a statement, the CHR Bicol said it will remain vigilant in protecting the rights and security of lawyers, human rights defenders, and other individuals who work to advance human rights and access to …

Présentation de la traduction du livre Chem Ka Rakiduam (pensée & action) de l'organisation mapuche révolutionnaire et autonomiste Coordinadora Arauco-Malleco (

CAM

)


DIMANCHE

 13 

SEPTEMBRE

 2026


14h au

CICP


23 Rue Voltaire, Paris


Au Wallmapu — les territoires mapuches occupés par les États chilien et argentin au sud du continent —, des luttes acharnées sont menées pour récupérer les terres accaparées par des investisseurs capitalistes, des entreprises forestières, des groupes énergétiques et de grands propriétaires terriens. Dans cette lutte tenace pour la libération, les communautés mapuches reconstruisent le monde mapuche en dépit de la répression, de la prison et de la militarisation. Leur cosmovision exprimant le lien profond entre tous les êtres vivants, la Terre animée et l'humain, s'oppose aux forces colonisatrices et prédatrices qui ravagent le monde.


La Coordinadora Arauco-Malleco (

CAM

), une organisation mapuche autonomiste, révolutionnaire et anticapitaliste agissant dans les territoires sous l'emprise de l'État chilien, a publié cet ouvrage afin de partager leur pensée, ainsi que leurs propositions de lutte fondées sur l'autonomie, l'action directe et la libération nationale :


«

 

En tant qu'organisation – et en tant qu'expression du mouvement autonomiste mapuche –, nous ressentons aujourd'hui le besoin de publier ce recueil de documents internes sur notre projet d'émancipation, de textes analytiques sur les actions du mouvement mapuche et de divers communiqués qui, à nos yeux, contribuent au débat et à la diffusion d'une perspective qui promeut fermement la lutte en cours pour la libération nationale mapuche. Nous avons également inclus des témoignages relatant une série d'actions de résistance menées par nos weychafe, tels que racontées par les participants eux-mêmes. Ces témoignages, jusqu'alors inédits, sont rendus publics afin d'expliquer en quoi les sabotages et l'autodéfense jouent un rôle fondamental dans la mobilisation des forces visant, d'une part, à chasser le pouvoir capitaliste de notre territoire et, d'autre part, à jeter les bases matérielles et spirituelles de notre projet de libération nationale mapuche.

 

»


320 pages // 14 euros


L'intégralité des ventes de ce livre seront reversées au soutien des prisonniers politiques mapuche.


Pour toute commande : tumult_anarchie [a] riseup.net ou via le

formulaire sécurisé sur notre site

.


***


Sommaire


Une brève histoire de la

CAM


Notre rakiduam


Notre pratique politique et les chems (actions)


Les défis pour le mouvement autonomiste mapuche


L'exacerbation coloniale du capitalisme néolibéral


Communiqués de la

CAM


Entretiens et lettres


***


Préface


Dans le cadre du conflit historique entre le Peuple-Nation mapuche, le capitalisme et un État de type colonial, nous, en tant que weychafe mapuche, guerriers et guerrières mapuches, sommes conscients que des temps difficiles, sombres et confus s'annoncent, comme nos pu machi, guides spirituels et guérisseurs mapuches nous l'ont déjà annoncé. Si le modèle d'accumulation capitaliste dans le Wallmapu reste intact depuis des décennies, la lutte révolutionnaire mapuche est confrontée à un nouveau cycle du pouvoir marqué, cette fois, par une double condition inédite : d'une part, le déploiement massif de l'appareil colonial bourgeois contre les processus de résistance mapuche afin de préserver les intérêts du grand capital et du monde des affaires, dont la principale manifestation est l'état d'exception et la militarisation du territoire qui s'étend depuis plusieurs mois déjà. D'autre part, à contre-courant médiatique de ce qui précède, le début d'un contexte marqué par les prétendues avancées progressistes issues de la révolte populaire de 2019, du moins dans la réalité chilienne.1


Cette première condition s'accompagne d'une longue histoire de spoliation et s'inscrit dans les structures de domination qui ont régné sur le Wallmapu depuis près de 500 ans. title: Zayıflama iğneleri tehlikeli mi? Bilim ne diyor, sağlıkçılar ne öneriyor?
content:
Kilo kaybı sağlayan ilaçlar, obezite tedavisinde önemli bir seçenek haline geldi. Ancak “zayıflama iğnesi” olarak bilinen bu ilaçlar masum birer kilo verme ürünü değil. Bilimsel çalışmalar etkili olduklarını gösterirken, ciddi yan etkiler ve yanlış kullanım riskleri de bulunuyor. İlaçların hekim değerlendirmesi ve yaşam tarzı değişiklikleriyle birlikte kullanılmasının ise önemi büyük.

Son yıllarda sosyal medyanın da etkisiyle kilo vermek isteyenlerin gündemine giren GLP-1 temelli ilaçlar, aslında başlangıçta özellikle tip 2 diyabetin tedavisinde kullanılan ilaçlar arasında yer alıyordu. Semaglutid ve tirzepatid gibi etken maddeler iştahı azaltıyor, tokluk hissini artırıyor ve kan şekeri düzenlenmesine yardımcı oluyor. Bu etkiler, obezite tedavisinde de kullanılmalarının önünü açtı.

Ancak bu ilaçları “hızlı kilo verme iğnesi” olarak görmek önemli bir yanılgı. Dünya Sağlık Örgütü (DSÖ), 2025'te yayımladığı kılavuzda semaglutid, tirzepatid ve liraglutid gibi GLP-1 ilaçlarının yetişkinlerde obezitenin uzun süreli tedavisinde kullanılabileceğini koşullu olarak önerdi. DSÖ, bunun yanında uzun dönem güvenlilik, tedavinin bırakılması sonrası ne olacağı, maliyet ve sağlık sistemlerinin bu tedavilere hazırlığı konusunda belirsizlikler bulunduğuna dikkat çekti.

Evet. Bu ilaçların kilo kaybı konusunda güçlü bilimsel kanıtları bulunuyor. Özellikle semaglutid ve tirzepatid, iştah ve enerji alımı üzerinde etkili olarak kişilerin daha az yemek yemesine yardımcı olabiliyor. Ancak alınan sonuç kişiden kişiye değişiyor ve ilaçların etkisi, tedavinin süresi ve kişinin yaşam tarzıyla yakından ilişkili.

Bu nedenle sağlık otoriteleri ilaçları diyet ve fiziksel aktivitenin alternatifi olarak değil, obezitenin kapsamlı tedavisinin bir parçası olarak değerlendiriyor. DSÖ de GLP-1 ilaçları kullanan obezitesi olan yetişkinlere yapılandırılmış sağlıklı beslenme ve fiziksel aktivite programlarının eşlik etmesini öneriyor.

Doğru hastada, uygun dozda ve hekim gözetiminde kullanıldığında bu ilaçların yararları ve riskleri klinik olarak değerlendirilmiş durumda. Ancak ciddi yan etki potansiyelleri nedeniyle gelişigüzel kullanılmaları güvenli değil.

En sık karşılaşılan sorunlar arasında bulantı, kusma, ishal, kabızlık, karın ağrısı, hazımsızlık gibi şikâyetler bulunuyor.

Bunların yanı sıra ilaçların resmi güvenlik bilgilerinde pankreatit, safra kesesi hastalıkları, böbrek hasarı ve ciddi gastrointestinal reaksiyonlar gibi daha önemli riskler de yer alıyor. Bazı hastalarda kan şekeri düşüklüğü ve diyabetik retinopati komplikasyonları da önem taşıyor.

Bu nedenle “yan etkisi sadece biraz mide bulantısı” şeklindeki yaklaşım doğru değil.

İlaçların etkili olabilmesi kadar doğru dozda kullanılması da önemli. Özellikle doktor kontrolü dışında kullanılan ürünlerde doz hataları ciddi problemlere yol açabiliyor. ABD Gıda ve İlaç Dairesi (FDA), onaysız veya bileşik olarak hazırlanan semaglutid ürünlerinde yanlış doz kullanımına bağlı olarak hastaneye yatış gerektiren vakalar bildirildiğini açıkladı.

Bildirilen sorunlar arasında şiddetli bulantı ve kusma, karın ağrısı, susuz kalma, pankreatit ve safra taşı bulunuyor.

Uzmanların en önemli uyarılarından biri de ilacın nereden temin edildiği. FDA, onaylanmamış semaglutid ve tirzepatid ürünlerinin güvenlilik, etkinlik ve kalite açısından piyasaya çıkmadan önce kurumun değerlendirmesinden geçmediğini belirtiyor.

Daha da önemlisi, kurum sahte semaglutid ve tirzepatid ürünleri tespit edildiğini; bazı ürünlerin etiketlerinde gerçekte bulunmayan eczanelerin isimlerinin dahi kullanılabildiğini bildiriyor.

Bu nedenle sosyal medya üzerinden, internet sitelerinden veya doktor değerlendirmesi olmadan satılan ürünler ile ruhsatlı ilaçların aynı şey olmadığı unutulmamalı.

Bu ilaçların temel kullanım alanı obezite veya belirli koşullarla aşırı kiloluluk gibi tıbbi durumların tedavisi. Sırf birkaç kilo vermek isteyen sağlıklı bir kişinin sosyal medyada gördüğü bir ilaçla kendi kendine tedaviye başlaması doğru değil. Tedavi kararı verilirken kişinin kilosunun yanı sıra boyu, vücut kitle indeksi, eşlik eden hastalıkları, kullandığı ilaçlar, beslenme alışkanlıkları ve diğer sağlık koşulları birlikte değerlendirilmeli.

Ayrıca gebelik söz konusu olduğunda GLP-1 tedavileri kullanılmamalı; DSÖ'nün obezite kılavuzu da hamile kadınları kapsam dışında bırakıyor.

Burada da önemli bir ayrıntı var. GLP-1 ilaçlarının iştah üzerindeki etkisi tedavi sürdüğü sürece devam eder. Tedavi bırakıldığında iştahın yeniden artması ve …

Lights, Camera, Action – Immediate Steps

To answer the question of why the December 4th execution of UHC CEO Brian Thompson happened seems easy. Denials, price gouging, and the health insurance industry at large. However, as one unravels the outpouring of stories and symbolism in its wake, one finds it difficult to wrestle into a specific activist program. The questions one runs into are so urgent, but so foundational, that they resist easy answers.

Who lives and who dies? Who is healed and who is hurt? Who takes resources and who loses them?

There are no quick fixes to this system’s problems. Even if you personally have good insurance coverage and good health, you have seen loved ones struggle to afford or access lifesaving care. You have seen the downstream effects of for-profit healthcare in rising costs, closed hospitals, under-staffing, wait times, bureaucratic obfuscation. You have seen people lose everything to cover cancer care, forced to choose between rescue inhalers and rent, while c-suites get rich off the blood in the streets. It is impossible to avoid the growing realization that there are no quick fixes to this system’s problems because this system is the problem.

This is a part of the reason the events of December 4th resonated across the globe. While the “united states” is particularly bad in this regard, paying substantially more for worse care, other countries still struggle. “britain” has such lengthy wait lists for gender affirming care that the system forces trans people out of the country. “canada” may have universal healthcare that makes public hospitals and clinics available, but even still, has increasingly privatized some care, leading to 17.5% of the population to significant medical debt,[1] and the healthcare regime also pushes disabled people toward assisted suicide programs.[2] In Cuba, healthcare is free but US sanctions manufacture health scarcity by blocking the flow of technologies and medications both to punish Cuba for fighting western imperial capitalism and as propaganda against free healthcare.[3]

Within the “united states”, attempts to revise policies for better health outcomes have met little success.4 This is because such attempts do not fundamentally change the power dynamic at play, so insurance companies and hospital corporations continue raising prices, deciding what care gets covered, and limiting available services regardless of what laws are passed or revoked. Reform is not the solution when the system kills for profit.

We do not want to simply renegotiate the terms of a hostage scenario. We want the power to no longer be hostages.
